intro.ar: مَنْ قَرَأَ حم السَّجْدَةَ کَانَتْ لَهُ نُوراً یَوْمَ الْقِیَامَةِ مَدَّ بَصَرِهِ وَ سُرُوراً وَ عَاشَ فِی هَذِهِ الدُّنْیَا مَحْمُوداً مَغْبُوطاً.
intro.fa: هرکس سوره‌ی حم سجده را بخواند تا جایی که چشم او کار می‌کند، در روز قیامت دارای نور و سرور خواهد بود و در طول زندگی‌اش در دنیا مورد ستایش و غبطه دیگران خواهد بود.
intro.en: Whoever recites Ha-Mim al-Sajdah will have a light on the Day of Resurrection extending as far as his sight can reach, as well as joy, and he will live in this world praised and envied by others.
intro.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 474
intro.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 89, p. 298; Nur al-Thaqalayn; al-Burhan

intro.ar: مَنْ قَرَأَ هَذِهِ السُّورَةَ أَعْطَاهُ اللَّهُ بِعَدَدِ حُرُوفِهَا عَشْرَ حَسَنَاتٍ وَ مَنْ کَتَبَهَا فِی إِنَاءٍ وَ غَسَلَهُ وَ عَجَنَ بِهِ عَجِیناً ثُمَّ سَحَقَهُ وَ أَسَفَّهُ کُلَّ مَنْ بِهِ وَجَعُ الْفُؤَادِ زَالَ عَنْهُ وَ بَرِئَ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی. وَ قَالَ الصَّادِقُ (علیه السلام): مَنْ کَتَبَهَا فِی إِنَاءٍ وَ مَحَاهَا بِمَاءِ الْمَطَرِ وَ سَحَقَ بِذَلِکَ الْمَاءِ کُحْلًا وَ تَکَحَّلَ بِهِ مَنْ فِی عَیْنِهِ بَیَاضٌ أَوْ رَمَدٌ زَالَ عَنْهُ ذَلِکَ الْوَجَعُ وَ لَمْ یَرْمَدْ بِهَا أَبَداً وَ إِنْ تَعَذَّرَ الْکُحْلُ فَلْیَغْسِلْ عَیْنَیْهِ بِذَلِکَ الْمَاءِ یَزُولُ عَنْهُ الرَّمَدُ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی.
intro.fa: [برهان در خوّاص سوره فصّلت آورده است:] از پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) روایت شده است: «هرکس این سوره را بخواند، خداوند در مقابل هر حرف آن به او ده برابر نیکی عطا خواهد کرد. اگر فردی آن را در داخل ظرفی بنویسد و آن را بشوید و در داخل آن خمیری درست کند سپس آن را پودر کند و آن را بخورد، اگر بیماری قلبی داشته باشد بیماری‌اش برطرف می‌شود و بهبود خواهد یافت». امام صادق (علیه السلام) می‌فرماید: «هرکس این سوره را در داخل ظرفی بنویسد و با آب معطّر آن را پاک نماید و سپس با آن آب، سرمه را پودر کند، اگر فردی که مبتلا به سپیدی در چشم یا چشم درد باشد و چشمانش را به‌وسیله‌ی آن سرمه بکشد، بیماری‌اش برطرف خواهد شد و هرگز دچار چشم درد نخواهد شد و اگر سرمه در دسترس نبود با همان آب، چشمش را بشوید. چرا که به اراده‌ی خداوند چشم درد او برطرف خواهد شد».
intro.en: The Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Whoever recites this Surah, Allah will grant him ten good deeds for every letter in it. And whoever writes it in a vessel, washes it, kneads dough with that water, then grinds it and consumes it, any heart ailment he has will depart from him, and he will be healed by the permission of Allah the Exalted." Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said: "Whoever writes it in a vessel, erases it with rainwater, grinds kohl with that water, and applies it to the eyes of someone who has a white spot (leukoma) or ophthalmia, that ailment will depart from him, and he will never suffer from ophthalmia again. If kohl is unavailable, let him wash his eyes with that water; the ophthalmia will depart from him by the permission of Allah the Exalted."
intro.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 474
intro.refs: Al-Burhan / Nur al-Thaqalayn; "And whoever writes it in a vessel... to the end" is omitted.

1.ar: شِعَارُنَا ... یَوْمِ الْأَحْزَابِ حم لَا یُنْصَرُونَ.
1.fa: شعار و ندای ما [مسلمانان] روز جنگ احزاب چنین بود: «حم، دشمنان یاری نخواهند شد».
1.en: Our slogan [as Muslims] on the day of the Battle of the Confederates (al-Ahzab) was: "Ha-Mim, they shall not be helped."
1.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), vol. 13, p. 474

1.ar: أَنَّ النَّبِیَّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) قَالَ لِعَمِّهِ عَبَّاسٍ یَوْمَ حُنیْنٍ نَاوِلْنِی مِنَ الْبَطْحَاءِ فَأَفْقَهَ اللَّهُ الْبَغْلَةَ کَلَامَهُ فَانْخَفَضَتْ بِهِ حَتَّی کَادَ بَطْنُهَا یَمَسُّ الْأَرْضَ فَتَنَاوَلَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) مِنَ الْحَصْبَاءِ فَنَفَخَ فِی وُجُوهِهِمْ وَ قَالَ شَاهَتِ الْوُجُوهُ حم، لَا یُنْصَرُونَ.
1.fa: پیغمبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) در روز حنین به عمویش عبّاس (فرمود: «از خاک به من بده»، و خدا سخن ایشان را به استر فهماند و آن حیوان پایین آمد تا نزدیک شد شکمش به زمین رسد، و رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله) مشتی ریگ برگرفت و به چهره‌ی آن‌ها پاشید و فرمود: «زشت باد این چهره‌ها حم یاری نخواهند شد»!
1.en: On the day of Hunayn, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said to his uncle Abbas, "Hand me some gravel from the ground." God made the mule understand his speech, so it lowered itself until its belly nearly touched the ground. The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) took a handful of gravel, blew it into their faces, and said, "May these faces be deformed; Ha Mim, they shall not be helped."
1.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 476

1.ar: احْمِلُوا بِأَجْمَعِکُمْ عَلَیْهِمْ بِسْمِ اللَّهُ حم لَا یُنْصَرُونَ وَ حَمَلَ هُوَ بِنَفْسِهِ وَ الْحَسَنَانِ (علیها السلام).
1.fa: امام (علیه السلام) فرمان حمله را صادر کرد و فرمود: «با نام خداوند «حم» همگی بر آنان حمله برید که آن‌ها یاری نخواهند شد! [شکست می‌خورند]». خود حضرت (علیه السلام) درحالی‌که فرزندانش، حسن و حسین (علیها السلام) ایشان را همراهی میکردند حملهور شدند.
1.en: The Imam (peace be upon him) issued the command to attack and said: "In the name of Allah, Ha-Mim, they shall not be helped [they will be defeated]; attack them all together!" He (peace be upon him) then charged forward himself, while his sons, al-Hasan and al-Husayn (peace be upon them), accompanied him.
1.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 476

1.ar: وَ أَمَّا حم فَمَعْنَاهُ الْحَمِیدُ الْمَجِید.
1.fa: «حم» حمید یعنی ستوده‌شده و پسندیده و مجید یعنی شریف و بزرگوار.
1.en: As for "Ha-Mim," its meaning is the Praised (al-Hamid) and the Glorious (al-Majid).
1.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 476

1.ar: عَنْ السَّجَّادِ زَیْنِ العَابِدِینَ (علیه السلام) فِی دُعَاءِ یَوْمِ الفِطْرِ فِی وَصْفِ النَّبِیِّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ قُلْتَ جَلَّ قَوْلُکَ لَهُ حِینَ اخْتَصَصْتَهُ بِمَا سَمَّیْتَهُ مِنَ الْأَسْمَاءِ طه ما أَنْزَلْنا عَلَیْکَ الْقُرْآنَ لِتَشْقی وَ قُلْتَ عَزَّ قَوْلُکَ یس وَ الْقُرْآنِ الْحَکِیمِ وَ قُلْتَ تَقَدَّسَتْ أَسْمَاؤُکَ ص وَ الْقُرْآنِ ذِی الذِّکْرِ وَ قُلْتَ عَظُمَتْ آلَاؤُکَ ق وَ الْقُرْآنِ الْمَجِیدِ فَخَصَصْتَهُ أَنْ جَعَلْتَهُ قَسَمَکَ حِینَ أَسْمَیْتَهُ وَ قَرَنْتَ الْقُرْآنَ بِهِ فَمَا فِی کِتَابِکَ مِنْ شَاهِدِ قَسَمٍ وَ الْقُرْآنُ مُرْدَفٌ بِهِ إِلَّا وَ هُوَ اسْمُهُ وَ ذَلِکَ شَرَفٌ شَرَّفْتَهُ بِهِ وَ فَضْلٌ بَعَثْتَهُ إِلَیْهِ تَعْجِزُ الْأَلْسُنُ وَ الْأَفْهَامُ عَنْ عِلْمِ وَصْفِ مُرَادِکَ بِهِ وَ تَکِلُّ عَنْ عِلْمِ شَأْنِکَ عَلَیْهِ فَقُلْتَ عَزَّ جَلَالُکَ فِی تَأْکِیدِ الْکِتَابِ وَ قَبُولِ مَا جَاءَ بِهِ هذا کِتابُنا یَنْطِقُ عَلَیْکُمْ بِالْحَقِ وَ قُلْتَ عَزَّیْتَ و جَلَّیْتَ {عَزَزْتَ وَ جَلَلْتَ} ما فَرَّطْنا فِی الْکِتابِ مِنْ شَیْءٍ وَ قُلْتَ تَبَارَکْتَ وَ تَعَالَیْتَ فِی عَامَّةِ ابْتِدَائِهِ الر کِتابٌ أُحْکِمَتْ آیاتُهُ وَ الر کِتابٌ أَنْزَلْناهُ وَ الر تِلْکَ آیاتُ الْکِتابِ الْمُبِینِ وَ الم ذلِکَ الْکِتابُ لا رَیْبَ فِیهِ وَ فِی أَمْثَالِهَا مِنْ سُوَرِ الطَّوَاسِینِ وَ الْحَوَامِیمِ فِی کُلِّ ذَلِکَ بَیَّنْتَ فِی الْکِتَابِ مَعَ الْقَسَمِ الَّذِی هُوَ اسْمُ مَنِ اخْتَصَصْتَهُ لِوَحْیِکَ وَ اسْتَوْدَعْتَهُ سِرَّ غَیْبِک.
1.en: It is narrated from al-Sajjad Zayn al-Abidin (peace be upon him) in the supplication for the day of Eid al-Fitr, describing the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family): "And You said—and Your word is majestic—to him, when You singled him out with the names You bestowed upon him: 'Ta-Ha. We have not sent down to you the Qur'an that you be distressed' (Ta-Ha: 1-2). And You said—and Your word is mighty: 'Ya-Sin. By the wise Qur'an' (Ya-Sin: 1-2). And You said—may Your names be sanctified: 'Sad. By the Qur'an, possessor of the Reminder' (Sad: 1). And You said—may Your bounties be great: 'Qaf. By the glorious Qur'an' (Qaf: 1). Thus, You distinguished him by making him Your oath when You named him, and You coupled the Qur'an with him. There is no witness of an oath in Your Book where the Qur'an is followed by it, except that it is his name. This is an honor with which You honored him, and a virtue You sent to him, such that tongues and understandings are incapable of knowing the description of Your intent by it, and are exhausted from knowing the extent of Your status regarding him. And You said—may Your majesty be mighty—in confirming the Book and the acceptance of what it brought: 'This, Our record, speaks about you in truth' (Al-Jathiya: 29). And You said—You are Mighty and Majestic: 'We have not neglected in the Book a thing' (Al-An'am: 38). And You said—may You be blessed and exalted—in the general beginning of it: 'Alif-Lam-Ra. A Book whose verses are perfected' (Hud: 1); 'A Book We have revealed to you' (Ibrahim: 1); 'Alif-Lam-Ra. These are the verses of the clear Book' (Yusuf: 1); 'Alif-Lam-Mim. This is the Book about which there is no doubt' (Al-Baqarah: 1-2); and in their likes from the Tawasim and Hawamim surahs. In all of that, You clarified in the Book, along with the oath—which is the name of the one whom You singled out for Your revelation and entrusted with the secret of Your unseen."
1.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 476
1.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 88, p. 8; Nur al-Thaqalayn; [with slight variations]

2.ar: عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) ... ثُمَّ قَالَ نَزَلَ جَبْرَئِیلُ عَلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) بِأَنَّ الْإِمَامَ بَعْدَهُ عَلِیٌّ (علیه السلام) ثُمَّ قَرَأَ (علیه السلام) حم تَنْزِیلٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِیمِ.
2.fa: امام صادق (علیه السلام) فرمود: ... جبرئیل بر پیامبر اکرم (صلی الله علیه و آله) نازل شد و گفت امام بعد از او، علی (علیه السلام) است. سپس امام صادق (علیه السلام) سوره: حم، تَنْزِیلٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِیمِ را خواند.
2.en: From Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him)... then he said: Gabriel descended upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) [to inform him] that the Imam after him is Ali (peace be upon him). Then he (peace be upon him) recited: "Ha-Mim. A revelation from the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful."
2.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 478
2.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 26, p. 96 / Ta'wil al-Ayat al-Zahira, p. 520 / Furat al-Kufi, p. 381

2.ar: لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ سُورَةُ الشُّعَرَاءِ فِی آخِرِهَا آیَةُ الْإِنْذَارِ وَ أَنْذِرْ عَشِیرَتَکَ الْأَقْرَبِینَ أَمَرَنِی رَسُولُ الله (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ قَالَ: یَا عَلِیُّ (علیه السلام) اطْبُخْ وَ لَوْ کُرَاعَ شَاةٍ وَ لَوْ صَاعاً مِنْ طَعَامٍ و قَعْباً مِنْ لَبَنٍ وَ اعْمِدْ إِلَی قُرَیْشٍ. قَالَ: فَدَعَوْتُهُمْ وَ اجْتَمَعُوا أَرْبَعِینَ بَطَلًا بِزِیَادَةٍ وَ کَانَ فِیهِمْ أَبُوطَالِبٍ (رحمة الله علیه) وَ حَمْزَةُ (رحمة الله علیه) وَ الْعَبَّاسُ؛ فَحَضَرْتُ مَا أَمَرَنِی بِهِ رَسُولُ اللهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) مَعْمُولًا، فَوَضَعْتُهُ بَیْنَ أَیْدِیهِمْ فَضَحِکُوا اسْتِهْزَاءً. فَأَدْخَلَ إِصْبَعَهُ رَسُولُ الله (صلی الله علیه و آله) بِأَرْبَعَةِ جَوَانِبِ الْجَفْنَةِ فَقَالَ کُلُوا وَ قُولُوا بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِیمِ. فَقَالَ أَبُوجَهْلٍ: یَا مُحَمَّدُ (صلی الله علیه و آله) مَا نَاکُلُ وَ أَحَدُنَا یَأْکُلُ الشَّاةَ مَعَ أَرْبَعَةِ أَصْوُعٍ مِنَ الطَّعَامِ؟ فَقَالَ: کُلْ وَ أَرِنِی أَکْلَکَ. فَأَکَلُوا حَتَّی تَمْلَؤُوا، وَ أَیْمُ اللَّهِ مَا یُرَی أَثَرُ أَکْلِ أَحَدِهِمْ وَ لَا نَقَصَ الزَّادُ. فَصَاحَ بِهِمْ رَسُولُ اللهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) کُلُوا. فَقَالُوا: وَ مَنْ یَقْدِرُ عَلَی أَکْثَرَ مِنْ هَذَا؟ فَقَالَ: ارْفَعْهُ یَا عَلِیُّ (علیه السلام). فَرَفَعْتُهُ فَدَنَا مِنْهُمْ مُحَمَّدٌ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ قَالَ: یَا قَوْمِ، اعْلَمُوا أَنَّ اللَّهَ رَبِّی وَ رَبُّکُمْ. فَصَاحَ أَبُولَهَبٍ، وَ قَالَ: قُومُوا إِنَّ مُحَمَّداً (صلی الله علیه و آله) سَحَرَکُمْ. فَقَامُوا وَ مَضَوْا فَاسْتَعْقَبَهُمْ عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (علیه السلام) وَ أَرَادَ أَنْ یَبْطِشَ بِهِمْ، فَقَالَ لَهُ رَسُولُ اللهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله): لَا یَا عَلِیُّ (علیه السلام) ادْنُ مِنِّی. فَتَرَکَهُمْ وَ دَنَا مِنْهُ. فَقَالَ لَهُ: أُمِرْنَا بِالْإِنْذَارِ لَا بِذَاتِ الْفِقَارِ، لِأَنَّ لَهُ وَقْتاً، وَ لَکِنِ اعْمَلْ لَنَا مِنَ الطَّعَامِ مِثْلَ مَا عَمِلْتَ وَ ادْعُ لِی مَنْ دَعَیْتَ {دَعَوْتَ}. فَلَمَّا أَتَی غَدٌ فَعَلْتُ مَا بِالْأَمْسِ فَعَلْتُ. فَلَمَّا اجْتَمَعُوا وَ أَکَلُوا کَمَا أَکَلُوا، فَقَالَ لَهُمْ رَسُولُ الله (صلی الله علیه و آله): مَا أَعْلَمُ شَابّاً مِنَ الْعَرَبِ جَاءَ قَوْمَهُ بِأَفْضَلِ مَا جِئْتُکُمْ بِهِ مِنْ أَمْرِ الدُّنْیَا وَ الْآخِرَةِ. قیِلَ: فَقَالَ أَبُوجَهْلٍ: قَدْ شَغَلَنَا أَمْرُ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَلَوْ قَابَلْتُمُوهُ بِرَجُلٍ مِثْلِهِ یَعْرِفُ السِّحْرَ وَ الْکِهَانَةَ لَکُنَّا اسْتَرَحْنَا؛ فَقَطَعَ کَلَامَهُ عُتْبَةُ بْنُ رَبِیعَةَ وَ قَالَ: وَ اللَّهِ إِنِّی لَبَصِیرٌ بِمَا ذَکَرْتَهُ. فَقَالَ: لِمَ لَا تُبَاحِثْهُ؟ قَالَ: حَاشَا أَنْ کَانَ بِهِ مَا ذَکَرْتَ. فَقَالَ لَهُ: یَا مُحَمَّدُ (صلی الله علیه و آله)! أَنْتَ خَیْرٌ أَمْ هَاشِمٌ؟ أَنْتَ خَیْرٌ أَمْ عَبْدُالْمُطَّلِبِ؟ أَنْتَ خَیْرٌ أَمْ عَبْدُاللهِ؟ أَنْتَ خَیْرٌ أَمْ عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (علیه السلام) دَامِغُ {دافِعُ} الْجَبَابِرَةِ قَاصِمُ أَصْلَابِ أَکْبَرِهِمْ؟ فَلِمَ تُضِلُّ آبَائَنَا وَ تَشْتِمُ آلِهَتَنَا؟ فَإِنْ کُنْتَ تُرِیدُ الرِّئَاسَةَ عَقَدْنَا لَکَ أَوْلَوِیَّتَهَا وَ کُنْ رَئِیساً لَنَا مَا بَقِیتَ، وَ إِنْ کَانَ بِکَ الْبَاهُ زَوَّجْنَاکَ عَشَرَةَ نِسْوَةٍ مِنْ أَکْبَرِنَا، وَ إِنْ کُنْتَ تُرِیدُ الْمَالَ جَمَعْنَا لَکَ مِنْ أَمْوَالِنَا مَا یُغْنِیکَ أَنْتَ وَ عَقِبَکَ مِنْ بَعْدِکَ، فَمَا تَقُولُ؟ فَقَال (صلی الله علیه و آله) بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِیمِ حم* تَنْزِیلٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِیمِ کِتابٌ فُصِّلَتْ آیاتُهُ قُرْآناً عَرَبِیًّا ... فَإِنْ أَعْرَضُوا فَقُلْ أَنْذَرْتُکُمْ صاعِقَةً مِثْلَ صاعِقَةِ عادٍ وَ ثَمُودَ فَأَمْسَکَ عُتْبَةُ عَلَی فِیهِ، وَ رَجَعَ فَنَاشَدَهُ بِاللَّهِ اسْکُتْ، فَسَکَتَ، وَ قَامَ وَ مَضَی، فَقَامَ مَنْ کَانَ حَاضِراً خَلْفَهُ فَلَمْ یَلْحَقُوهُ، فَدَخَلَ وَ لَمْ یَخْرُجْ أَبَداً، فَغَدَوْهُ قُرَیْشٌ. فَقَالَ أَبُوجَهْلٍ: قُومُوا بِنَا إِلَیْهِ. فَدَخَلُوا وَ جَلَسُوا، فَقَالَ أَبُوجَهْلٍ: یَا عُتْبُةُ، مُحَمَّدٌ (صلی الله علیه و آله) سَحَرَکَ. فَقَامَ قَائِماً عَلَی قَدَمَیْهِ وَ قَالَ: یَا لُکَعَ الرِّجَالِ، وَ اللَّهِ لَوْ لَمْ تَکُنْ بِبَیْتِی لَقَتَلْتُکَ شَرَّ قِتْلَةٍ، یَا وَیْلَکَ، قُلْتَ: مُحَمَّدٌ سَاحِرٌ کَاهِنٌ شاعِرٌ، سِرْنَا إِلَیْهِ سَمِعْنَاهُ تَکَلَّمَ بِکَلَامٍ مِنْ رَبِّ السَّمَاءِ فَحَلَّفْتُهُ وَ أَمْسَکَ، وَ قَدْ سَمَّیْتُمُوهُ الصَّادِقَ الْأَمِینَ، هَلْ رَأَیْتُمْ مِنْهُ کَذِبَةً؟ وَ لَکِنِّی لَوْ تَرَکْتُهُ یُتَمِّمُ مَا قَرَأَ، لَحَلَّ بِکُمْ الْعَذَابُ وَ الذَّهَابُ.
2.en: When the Surah al-Shu'ara was revealed, at the end of which is the verse of warning: "And warn your nearest kinsmen," the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) commanded me and said: "O Ali (peace be upon him), prepare food, even if it be only a sheep's trotter, a sa' of grain, and a bowl of milk, and go to the Quraysh." I invited them, and they gathered—forty heroes and more. Among them were Abu Talib (may Allah have mercy on him), Hamzah (may Allah have mercy on him), and al-Abbas. I presented what the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) had commanded me to prepare, and I placed it before them. They laughed in mockery. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) inserted his finger into the four sides of the bowl and said: "Eat, and say: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful." Abu Jahl said: "O Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), how can we eat, when one of us usually eats a whole sheep with four sa's of food?" He replied: "Eat, and show me your eating." They ate until they were full, and by Allah, the traces of their eating were not visible in the bowl, nor did the food decrease. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) called out to them: "Eat." They said: "Who could possibly eat more than this?" He said: "Remove it, O Ali (peace be upon him)." I removed it, and Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) drew near to them and said: "O people, know that Allah is my Lord and your Lord." Abu Lahab shouted and said: "Rise, for Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) has bewitched you." They stood up and left. Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) followed them, intending to strike them, but the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to him: "No, O Ali (peace be upon him), come near to me." He left them and drew near to him. He said to him: "We have been commanded to warn, not to use the Dhu al-Fiqar, for that has its own time. Instead, prepare for us food like you did before, and invite those whom you invited." When the next day came, I did as I had done the day before. When they gathered and ate as they had eaten, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to them: "I do not know of any young man among the Arabs who has brought to his people anything better than what I have brought you regarding the affairs of this world and the Hereafter." It is said that Abu Jahl then said: "The affair of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) has preoccupied us. If you were to confront him with a man like him who knows magic and divination, we would be relieved." Utbah ibn Rabi'ah interrupted his speech and said: "By Allah, I am insightful regarding what you have mentioned." He asked: "Why do you not debate him?" He replied: "Far be it that he should be what you have described." He then said to him: "O Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family)! Are you better, or Hashim? Are you better, or Abd al-Muttalib? Are you better, or Abdullah? Are you better, or Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him), the crusher of tyrants and the breaker of the spines of the greatest among them? Why do you lead our fathers astray and insult our gods? If you desire leadership, we will grant you precedence and you shall be our leader as long as you live. If you desire women, we will marry you to ten of our most noble women. And if you desire wealth, we will gather for you from our wealth what will suffice you and your descendants after you. What do you say?" The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) replied: "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. Ha Mim. A revelation from the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Quran... But if they turn away, then say: 'I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt of 'Ad and Thamud.'" Utbah placed his hand over his mouth and begged him by Allah to be silent. He fell silent, stood up, and left. Those who were present stood up behind him, but they could not catch him. He entered his house and never came out again. The next morning, the Quraysh went to him. Abu Jahl said: "Rise, let us go to him." They entered and sat down. Abu Jahl said: "O Utbah, Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) has bewitched you." He stood up on his feet and said: "O base man! By Allah, if you were not in my house, I would have killed you in the worst way. Woe to you! You said: 'Muhammad is a magician, a soothsayer, a poet.' We went to him and heard him speak words from the Lord of the heavens. I adjured him, and he stopped. You yourselves have named him 'the Truthful, the Trustworthy.' Have you ever seen him tell a lie? But if I had let him finish what he was reciting, the punishment and destruction would have befallen you."
2.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 478

3.ar: قَوْلُهُ فُصِّلَتْ آیاتُهُ أَیْ بُیِّنَ حَلَالُهَا وَ حَرَامُهَا وَ أَحْکَامُهَا وَ سُنَنُهَا.
3.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- کِتَابٌ فُصِّلتْ آیَاتُهُ قُرْآنًا عَرَبِیًّا لقَومٍ یَعْلمُونَ بدین معناست که حلال و حرام و سنّت‌های آن مشخص شده است.
3.en: His saying, "Its verses have been detailed," means its lawful and unlawful matters, its rulings, and its traditions have been made clear.
3.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 480
3.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 233; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 261; Al-Burhan

4.ar: نَزَلَ جَبْرَئِیلُ عَلَی رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) بِأَنَّ الْإِمَامَ بَعْدَهُ عَلِیٌّ (علیه السلام) ثُمَّ قَرَأَ (علیه السلام) حم تَنْزِیلٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِیمِ کِتابٌ فُصِّلَتْ آیاتُهُ قُرْآناً عَرَبِیًّا لِقَوْمٍ یَعْلَمُون حَتَّی بَلَغَ فَأَعْرَضَ أَکْثَرُهُمْ عَنْ وَلَایَةِ عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) فَهُمْ لایَسْمَعُونَ حَتَّی عامِلُونَ.
4.fa: جبرئیل بر پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) نازل شد و گفت امام بعد از او علی (علیه السلام) است؛ سپس سوره: حم* تَنْزِیلٌ مِنَ الرَّحْمنِ الرَّحِیمِ* کِتابٌ فُصِّلَتْ آیاتُهُ قُرْآناً عَرَبِیًّا لِقَوْمٍ یَعْلَمُونَ خواند تا رسید به فَأَعْرَضَ أَکْثَرُهُمْ. بیشتر آن‌ها از ولایت علی (علیه السلام) اعراض کردند آن‌ها [حقایق را] نمی‌شنوند آن‌ها گفتند: «قلبهای ما نسبت به آنچه ما را به آن دعوت می‌کنی در پوشش‌هایی قرار گرفته و در گوش‌های ما سنگینی است، و میان ما و تو حجابی وجود دارد پس تو به دنبال عمل خود باش، ما هم برای خود عمل می‌کنیم!
4.en: Gabriel descended upon the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) [to declare] that the Imam after him is Ali (peace be upon him). Then he (peace be upon him) recited: "Ha-Mim. A revelation from the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful. A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Quran for a people who know," until he reached: "But most of them turned away from the wilayah (guardianship) of Ali (peace be upon him), so they do not hear." [They said]: "Our hearts are within coverings from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work, indeed we are working."
4.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 480
4.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 36, p. 144; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 26, p. 96; [In some sources] "that the Imam... who know" is omitted, and "until we are working" is omitted; Al-Burhan; [In some sources] "until we are working" is omitted.

4.ar: بَشِیراً وَ نَذِیراً أَیْ یُبَشِّرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ وَ یُنْذِرُ الظَّالِمِینَ فَأَعْرَضَ أَکْثَرُهُمْ یَعْنِی عَنِ الْقُرْآنِ.
4.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- بَشِیرًا یعنی به مؤمنان مژده می‌دهد، و نَذِیرًا به‌معنای این است که تهدیدکننده‌ی ظالمان است. فَأَعْرَضَ أَکْثَرُهُمْ امّا بیشتر آن‌ها از قرآن دوری کردند.
4.en: "Bashiran" (a bearer of glad tidings) means he gives glad tidings to the believers, and "Nadhiran" (a warner) means he warns the wrongdoers. "Fa-a'rada aktharuhum" (but most of them turned away) means they turned away from the Quran.
4.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 480

5.ar: فِی رِوَایَةِ أَبِی الْجَارُودِ عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) فِی قَوْلِهِ لَهُمْ قُلُوبٌ لا یَفْقَهُونَ بِها یَقُولُ: طَبَعَ اللَّهُ عَلَیْهَا فَلَا تَعْقِلُ وَ لَهُمْ أَعْیُنٌ عَلَیْهَا غِطَاءٌ عَنِ الْهُدَی لا یُبْصِرُونَ بِها وَ لَهُمْ آذانٌ لا یَسْمَعُونَ بِها جَعَلَ فِی آذَانِهِمْ وَقْراً فَلَمْ یَسْمَعُوا الْهُدَی.
5.en: In the narration of Abu al-Jarud, from Abu Ja’far (peace be upon him), regarding the verse: "They have hearts with which they do not understand," he said: God has set a seal upon them, so they do not reason. "And they have eyes with which they do not see," meaning there is a covering over them that prevents them from seeing guidance. "And they have ears with which they do not hear," meaning God has placed deafness in their ears, so they do not hear the guidance.
5.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 482
5.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 5, p. 197; Nur al-Thaqalayn

5.ar: وَ قالُوا قُلُوبُنا فِی أَکِنَّةٍ أَیْ فِی غِشَاوَةٍ مِمَّا تَدْعُونَا إِلَیْهِ وَ فِی آذَانِنَا وَقْرٌ وَ مِنْ بَیْنِنَا وَ بَیْنِکَ حِجابٌ فَاعْمَلْ إِنَّنا عَامِلُونَ أَیْ تَدْعُونَا إِلَی مَا لَا نَفْهَمُهُ وَ لَا نَعْقِلُهُ.
5.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- أَکِنَّةٍ به‌معنای پوشش است. فَهُمْ لا یَسْمَعُونَ* وقَالوا قُلوبُنَا فِی أَکِنَّةٍ مِّمَّا تَدْعُونَا إِلیْهِ و فِی آذَانِنَا وقْرٌ ومِن بَیْنِنَا و بَیْنِکَ حِجَابٌ فَاعْمَلْ إِنَّنا عامِلُونَ یعنی شما ما را به چیزی دعوت می‌کنید که آن را نمی‌فهمیم و درک نمی‌کنیم.
5.en: "And they said, 'Our hearts are within coverings'—that is, in a veil—'from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work; indeed, we are working'—that is, you invite us to that which we do not understand and do not comprehend."
5.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 482
5.refs: Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 261 / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 233; "that is, in a veil" is omitted [in some versions], and "and in our ears... we are working" is omitted [in some versions].

5.ar: یُؤْمِنُونَ بِبَعْضِ مَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی وَ یَکْفُرُونَ بِبَعْضٍ، فَإِذَا کَذَّبُوا مُحَمَّداً (صلی الله علیه و آله) فِی سَائِرِ مَا یَقُولُ، فَقَدْ صَارَ مَا کَذَّبُوا بِهِ أَکْثَرَ، وَ مَا صَدَّقُوا بِهِ أَقَلَّ. وَ إِذَا قُرِئَ غُلْفٌ فَإِنَّهُمْ قَالُوا: قُلُوبُنَا {غُلْفٌ} فِی غِطَاءٍ، فَلَا نَفْهَمُ کَلَامَکَ وَ حَدِیثَکَ. نَحْوَ مَا قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی: وَ قالُوا قُلُوبُنا فِی أَکِنَّةٍ مِمَّا تَدْعُونا إِلَیْهِ وَ فِی آذانِنا وَقْرٌ وَ مِنْ بَیْنِنا وَ بَیْنِکَ حِجابٌ وَ کِلَا الْقِرَاءَتَیْنِ حَقٌّ، وَ قَدْ قَالُوا بِهَذَا وَ بِهَذَا جَمِیعا.
5.fa: ایمان به بعضی از آنچه خدا فرستاده دارند و برخ دیگر را کافرند وقتی حضرت محمّد (صلی الله علیه و آله) را در مورد سایر گفتارش تکذیب نمایند تکذیب ایشان از تصدیقشان بیشتر می‌شود؛ امّا اگر قرائت شود غُلْفٌ منظورشان این است که دل‌های ما در پس پرده‌ایست و گفتار و حدیث تو را نمی‌فهمیم. شبیه این آیه است که خداوند می‌فرماید: وَ قالُوا قُلُوبُنا فِی أَکِنَّةٍ مِمَّا تَدْعُونا إِلَیْهِ وَ فِی آذانِنا وَقْرٌ وَ مِنْ بَیْنِنا وَ بَیْنِکَ حِجابٌ و هر دو قرائت درست است آن‌ها مدّعی هر دو جهت شده‌اند.
5.en: They believe in some of what Allah the Exalted has sent down and disbelieve in some. Thus, when they deny Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) regarding the rest of what he says, that which they have denied becomes greater, and that which they have believed in becomes less. And when it is recited as "ghulf" (covered), they mean: "Our hearts are [covered] in a veil, so we do not understand your speech or your discourse." This is similar to what Allah the Exalted said: "And they said, 'Our hearts are within coverings from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition.'" Both recitations are true, and they have indeed said both of these things.
5.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 482
5.refs: Al-Askari, p. 390; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 320; and Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 67, p. 170; "They believe in some... similar to what Allah said" is omitted.

7.ar: قَوْلُهُ فَاسْتَقِیمُوا إِلَیْهِ أَیْ أَجِیبُوهُ قَوْلُهُ وَ وَیْلٌ لِلْمُشْرِکِینَ هُمُ الَّذِینَ أَقَرُّوا بِالْإِسْلَامِ وَ أَشْرَکُوا بِالْأَعْمَالِ.
7.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- فَاسْتَقِیمُوا إِلَیْهِ یعنی او را اجابت کنید. آیه: وَ وَیْلٌ لِلْمُشْرِکِینَ؛ آن‌ها کسانی هستند که اقرار به اسلام و شرک در اعمال دارند.
7.en: His saying: "So take a straight course to Him" means: Respond to Him. His saying: "And woe to the polytheists" refers to those who professed Islam but committed polytheism in their deeds.
7.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 482
7.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 233; al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 261

7.ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله): أَیُّهَا النَّاسُ اسْتَقِیمُوا إِلَی رَبِّکُمْ کَمَا قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی: فَاسْتَقِیمُوا إِلَیْهِ وَ اسْتَغْفِرُوهُ وَ قَالَ سُبْحَانَهُ: إِنَّ الَّذِینَ قالُوا رَبُّنَا اللهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَقامُوا أَیُّهَا النَّاسُ وَ لا تَکُونُوا کَالَّتِی نَقَضَتْ غَزْلَها مِنْ بَعْدِ قُوَّةٍ أَنْکاثاً تَتَّخِذُونَ أَیْمانَکُمْ دَخَلًا بَیْنَکُمْ وَ اعْلَمُوا أَنَّهُ مَنْ لَمْ یَکُنْ مُسْتَقِیماً فِی صِفَتِهِ لَمْ یَرْتَقِ مِنْ مَقَامٍ إِلَی غَیْرِهِ وَ لَمْ یَتَبَیَّنْ سُلُوکَهُ عَلَی صِحَّةٍ وَ لَمْ تَخْرُجُوا مِنْ عِزِّ التَّقْوَی إِلَی ذُلِّ الْمَعْصِیَةِ وَ لَا مِنْ أُنْسِ الطَّاعَةِ إِلَی وَحْشَةِ الْخَطِیئَةِ وَ لَا تُسِرُّوا لِإِخْوَانِکُمْ غِشّاً فَإِنَّ مَنْ أَسَرَّ لِأَخِیهِ غِشّاً أَظْهَرَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَی صَفَحَاتِ وَجْهِهِ وَ فَلَتَاتِ لِسَانِهِ فَأَوْرَثَهُ بِهِ الذُّلَّ فِی الدُّنْیَا وَ الْخِزْیَ وَ الْعَذَابَ وَ النَّدَامَةَ فِی الْآخِرَةِ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ الْخَاسِرِینَ أَعْمَالا.
7.en: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "O people, remain steadfast toward your Lord, just as Allah the Exalted has said: 'So be steadfast toward Him and seek His forgiveness' (41:6), and as He, the Glorified, has said: 'Indeed, those who have said, "Our Lord is Allah," and then remained steadfast' (41:30). O people, do not be like the woman who unraveled her spun thread into fibers after it had been strong, taking your oaths as a means of deception between you. Know that whoever is not steadfast in their character will not ascend from one station to another, nor will their conduct be established upon correctness. Do not depart from the honor of piety to the humiliation of disobedience, nor from the intimacy of obedience to the desolation of sin. Do not harbor deceit toward your brothers, for whoever harbors deceit toward his brother, Allah will manifest it upon the surfaces of his face and the slips of his tongue, thereby inheriting him humiliation in this world, and disgrace, torment, and regret in the Hereafter, and he shall become among the losers in deeds."
7.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 482

7.ar: عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ قَالَ: قَالَ لِی أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّه (علیه السلام): یَا أَبَانُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَایَطْلُبُ مِنَ الْمُشْرِکِینَ زَکَاةَ أَمْوَالِهِمْ وَ هُمْ یُشْرِکُونَ بِهِ حَیْثُ یَقُولُ وَ وَیْلٌ لِلْمُشْرِکِینَ الَّذِینَ لا یُؤْتُونَ الزَّکاةَ وَ هُمْ بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ کافِرُونَ قُلْتُ لَهُ کَیْفَ ذَاکَ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاکَ فَسِّرْهُ لِی فَقَالَ وَیْلٌ لِلْمُشْرِکِینَ الَّذِینَ أَشْرَکُوا بِالْإِمَامِ الْأَوَّلِ وَ هُمْ بِالْأَئِمَّةِ (علیهم السلام) الْآخِرِینَ کَافِرُونَ یَا أَبَانُ إِنَّمَا دَعَا اللَّهُ الْعِبَادَ إِلَی الْإِیمَانِ بِهِ فَإِذَا آمَنُوا بِاللَّهِ وَ بِرَسُولِهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) افْتَرَضَ عَلَیْهِمُ الْفَرَائِضُ.
7.fa: ابان‌بن‌تغلب گوید: امام صادق (علیه السلام) به من فرمود: «ای ابان! خداوند از مشرکین زکات مالشان را درحالی‌که مشرک باشند نخواسته است. چنانچه در این آیه می‌فرماید: وَ وَیْلٌ لِلْمُشْرِکِینَ* الَّذِینَ لا یُؤْتُونَ الزَّکاةَ وَ هُمْ بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ کافِرُونَ». عرض کردم: «فدایت شوم! این مطلب را برایم توضیح بدهید». فرمود: «وای بر مشرکین که در مورد امام اوّل شرک آوردند و آن‌ها در مورد ائمه (علیهم السلام) دیگر هم کافرند. ابان! خداوند مردم را دعوت به ایمان به خود کرده وقتی ایمان به خدا و پیامبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) آوردند واجبات بر آن‌ها لازم می‌شود».
7.en: Aban ibn Taghlib said: Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) said to me: "O Aban, God does not demand the zakat of their wealth from the polytheists while they are associating partners with Him, as He says: 'And woe to the polytheists, who do not give zakat, and they are disbelievers in the Hereafter.' I said to him: 'May I be made your sacrifice, how is that? Explain it to me.' He said: 'Woe to the polytheists who associated partners with the first Imam, and they are disbelievers regarding the subsequent Imams (peace be upon them). O Aban, God only called the servants to believe in Him; when they believe in God and His Messenger (peace be upon him and his family), the obligatory duties become binding upon them.'"
7.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 484
7.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 23, p. 83; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 262 and Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 9, p. 233; "Do you think that God demanded" instead of "God does not demand"; Ta'wil al-Ayat al-Zahira, p. 521; "Do you think that God demanded" instead of "God does not demand" and "O Aban, God only..." until the end is omitted; Ta'wil al-Ayat al-Zahira, p. 521; Al-Burhan; Nur al-Thaqalayn

7.ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا سَأَلَهُ فَقَالَ یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) قَوْلُ اللَّهِ عَزَّوجَلَّ وَ وَیْلٌ لِلْمُشْرِکِینَ الَّذِینَ لا یُؤْتُونَ الزَّکاةَ وَ هُمْ بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ کافِرُونَ قَالَ لَا یُعَاتِبُ اللَّهُ الْمُشْرِکِینَ أَ مَا سَمِعْتَ قَوْلَهُ فَوَیْلٌ لِلْمُصَلِّینَ الَّذِینَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلاتِهِمْ ساهُونَ الَّذِینَ هُمْ یُراؤُنَ وَ یَمْنَعُونَ الْماعُونَ أَلَا إِنَّ الْمَاعُونَ الزَّکَاةُ ثُمَّ قَالَ وَ الَّذِی نَفْسُ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلی الله علیه و آله) بِیَدِهِ مَا خَانَ اللَّهَ أَحَدٌ شَیْئاً مِنْ زَکَاةِ مَالِهِ إِلَّا مُشْرِکٌ بِاللَّهِ.
7.en: A man asked him, saying, "O Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family), what is the meaning of the words of God, the Almighty and Majestic: 'And woe to the polytheists, who do not give Zakat and are disbelievers in the Hereafter'?" He replied, "God does not reproach the polytheists [in this context]. Have you not heard His words: 'So woe to those who pray, who are heedless of their prayer, who make a show of their deeds, and withhold the Ma'un (essential needs)'? Verily, the Ma'un is Zakat." Then he said, "By Him in whose hand is the soul of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), no one betrays God regarding any part of the Zakat of their wealth except one who is a polytheist toward God."
7.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 484
7.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 93, p. 29; Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, Vol. 7, p. 24; Da'a'im al-Islam, Vol. 1, p. 247; "Those who are heedless of their prayer, who make a show of their deeds" is omitted [in the Arabic text], and "toward God" is omitted.

7.ar: مَنْ أَشْرَکَ مَعَ إِمَامٍ إِمَامَتُهُ مِنْ عِنْدِ اللَّهِ مَنْ لَیْسَتْ إِمَامَتُهُ مِنَ اللَّهِ کَانَ مُشْرِکاً.
7.fa: هرکه شخصی را که از جانب خدا به امامت منصوب نشده با امامی که از جانب خدا تعیین شده است شریک قرار دهد، مشرک خواهد بود.
7.en: Whoever associates with an Imam whose Imamate is from God, one whose Imamate is not from God, is a polytheist (mushrik).
7.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 484

7.ar: فِی زِیَارَةِ الجَامِعَةِ: مَنْ جَحَدَکُمْ کَافِرٌ وَ مَنْ حَارَبَکُمْ مُشْرِ.
7.fa: در زیارت جامعه آمده است: «و هرکه شما را انکار کرد کافر است، و هرکه با شما به جنگ برخاست مشرک است».
7.en: In the Ziyarat al-Jami'ah it is stated: "Whoever denies you is a disbeliever (kafir), and whoever wages war against you is a polytheist (mushrik)."
7.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), vol. 13, p. 484

7.ar: عَنْ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ (علیه السلام) أَنَّهُ قَالَ: قَالَ أَبِی رِضْوَانُ اللَّهِ عَلَیْهِ یَوْماً لِجَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ الْأَنْصَارِیِّ: یَا جَابِرُ، هَلْ فَرَضَ اللَّهُ الزَّکَاةَ عَلَی مُشْرِکٍ؟ قَالَ: لَا إِنَّمَا فَرَضَهَا عَلَی الْمُسْلِمِینَ. قُلْتُ أَنَا لَهُ: فَأَیْنَ أَنْتَ مِنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ وَ وَیْلٌ لِلْمُشْرِکِینَ الَّذِینَ لَا یُؤْتُونَ الزَّکاةَ؟ قَالَ جَابِرٌ: کَأَنِّی - وَ اللَّه ِ- مَا قَرَأْتُهَا وَ إِنَّهَا لَفِی کِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّوَجَلَّ. قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام): فَنَزَلَتْ فِیمَنْ أَشْرَکَ بِوَلَایَةِ أَمِیرِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (علیه السلام) وَ أَعْطَی زَکَاتَهُ مَنْ نَصَبَ نَفْسَهُ دُونَه.
7.fa: امام صادق (علیه السلام) فرمود: روزی پدرم امام باقر (علیه السلام) به جابربن‌عبدالله انصاری فرمود: «ای جابر! آیا خداوند زکات را بر انسان مشرک واجب نموده است»؟ جابر پاسخ داد: «خیر، خداوند زکات را بر مسلمانان واجب ساخته است». من به جابر گفتم: «پس نظرت درباره‌ی این کلام خداوند که فرموده وَ وَیْلٌ لِلْمُشْرِکِینَ الَّذِینَ لا یُؤْتُونَ الزَّکاةَ چیست»؟! جابر پاسخ داد: «سوگند به خدا! با اینکه این آیه در کتاب خداوند عزّوجلّ است ولی گویا تاکنون آن را نخوانده بودم»! امام صادق (علیه السلام) فرمود: «این آیه در مورد کسانی نازل شده که در ولایت امیرمؤمنان علی (علیه السلام) شرک ورزیده و زکاتشان را به کسی پرداخت نموده‌اند که خود را [غاصبانه] به‌جای حضرت گماشته است».
7.en: Ja’far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon him) narrated: My father (may Allah be pleased with him) said one day to Jabir ibn ‘Abd Allah al-Ansari: "O Jabir, has Allah made Zakat obligatory upon a polytheist (mushrik)?" Jabir replied: "No, He has only made it obligatory upon the Muslims." I said to him: "Then what is your take on the words of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: 'And woe to the polytheists, who do not give Zakat'?" Jabir said: "By Allah, it is as if I had never read it, even though it is in the Book of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic." Imam Abu ‘Abd Allah (peace be upon him) said: "It was revealed concerning those who committed shirk (polytheism) regarding the Wilayah of the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) and gave their Zakat to one who set himself up in his place."
7.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 484

7.ar: الَّذِینَ لا یُؤْتُونَ الزَّکاةَ وَ هُمْ بِالْآخِرَةِ هُمْ کافِرُونَ یَعْنِی مَنْ لَمْ یَدْفَعِ الزَّکَاةَ فَهُوَ کَافِرٌ.
7.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- خداوند فرموده است: الذِینَ لا یُؤْتُونَ الزَّکَاةَ و هُم بِالآخِرَةِ هُمْ کَافِرُونَ یعنی هرکس زکات را نپردازد، کافر است.
7.en: "Those who do not give Zakat and who are disbelievers in the Hereafter" means whoever does not pay Zakat is a disbeliever.
7.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 486

7.ar: نَحْنُ الصَّلَاةُ فِی کِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ نَحْنُ الزَّکَاة.
7.fa: در کتاب الهی (قرآن)، ما نماز و زکات هستیم.
7.en: We are the prayer (Salah) in the Book of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, and we are the alms (Zakah).
7.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 486

8.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا وَ عَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَیْرُ مَمْنُونٍ عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِب (علیه السلام).
8.fa: إِنَّ الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا وَ عَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَیْرُ مَمْنُونٍ؛ [منظور] امام علی (علیه السلام) است.
8.en: "Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds, for them is a reward uninterrupted" [refers to] Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him).
8.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 486
8.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 35, p. 341; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 35, p. 341

8.ar: إِنَّ الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا وَ عَمِلُوا الصَّالِحاتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَیْرُ مَمْنُونٍ أَیْ بِلََا مَنٍّ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَلَیْهِمْ بِمَا یَأْجُرُهُمْ بِهِ.
8.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- إِنَّ الذِینَ آمَنُوا و عَمِلوا الصَّالحَاتِ لهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَیْرُ مَمْنُونٍ؛ یعنی بدون اینکه از سوی خداوند در مقابل پاداششان بر آن‌ها منّت گذاشته شود، به ایشان جزا داده می‌شود.
8.en: "Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds, for them is a reward uninterrupted" (41:8); meaning, they are rewarded without Allah placing any obligation upon them for the reward He gives them.
8.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 486
8.refs: Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 262/ Al-Burhan; "ya'muruhum" (He commands them) instead of "ya'juruhum" (He rewards them).

9.ar: وَ مَعْنَی یَوْمَیْنِ أَیْ وَقْتَیْنِ ابْتِدَاءُ الْخَلْقِ وَ انْقِضَاؤُه.
9.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- یعنی در دو وقت؛ آغاز آفرینش و پایانش.
9.en: And the meaning of "two days" is two periods: the beginning of creation and its conclusion.
9.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 486
9.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 54, p. 60 / Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 262; "wa-inqida'uhu" is omitted.

9.ar: فَلَمَّا أَخَذَ فِی رِزْقِ خَلْقِهِ خَلَقَ السَّمَاءَ وَ جَنَّاتِهَا وَ الْمَلَائِکَةَ یَوْمَ الْخَمِیسِ وَ خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ یَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ وَ خَلَقَ دَوَابَّ الْبَرِّ وَ الْبَحْرِ یَوْمَ الْإِثْنَیْنِ وَ هُمَا الْیَوْمَانِ اللَّذَانِ یَقُولُ اللَّهُ عَزَّوجَلَّ أَ إِنَّکُمْ لَتَکْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِی خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فِی یَوْمَیْن.
9.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- زمانی‌که آفرینش روزی مخلوقاتش را شروع کرد، آسمان و بهشت و فرشته‌ها را روز پنج شنبه آفرید، و زمین را یک شنبه، و جانوران بیابان و دریا را روز دوشنبه و آن دو روزی است که خدای عزّوجلّ فرماید: أَ‌إِنَّکُمْ لَتَکْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِی خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فِی یَوْمَیْن.
9.en: When He began the provision for His creation, He created the heaven, its gardens, and the angels on Thursday. He created the earth on Sunday, and He created the beasts of the land and the sea on Monday. These are the two days regarding which Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, says: "Do you indeed disbelieve in Him who created the earth in two days?"
9.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 486

9.ar: وَ خَلَقَ الْجِبَالَ فِیهَا وَ أَقْوَاتَ أَهْلِهَا وَ شَجَرَهَا وَ مَا یَنْبَغِی لَهَا فِی یَوْمَیْنِ فِی یَوْمِ الثَّلَاثَاءِ وَ یَوْمِ الْأَرْبِعَاءِ کَمَا قَالَ تَعَالَی أَ إِنَّکُمْ لَتَکْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِی خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فِی یَوْمَیْنِ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَوی إِلَی السَّماءِ وَ هِیَ دُخانٌ فَکَانَ ذَلِکَ الدُّخَانُ مِنْ نَفْسِ الْمَاءِ حِینَ تَنَفَّسَ فَجَعَلَهَا سَمَاءً وَاحِدَةً ثُمَّ فَتَقَهَا وَ جَعَلَهَا سَبْعاً فِی یَوْمَیْنِ فِی یَوْمِ الْخَمِیسِ وَ یَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ إِنَّمَا سُمِّیَ بِالْجُمُعَةِ لِأَنَّهُ جُمِعَ فِیهِ خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ قَالَ تَعَالَی وَ أَوْحی فِی کُلِّ سَماءٍ أَمْرَها أَیْ وَ جَعَلَ فِی کُلِّ سَمَاءٍ خَلْقَهَا مِنَ الْمَلَائِکَةِ وَ الْبِحَارِ وَ جِبَالِ الْبَرَدِ.
9.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (- کوه‌ها و درخت‌ها و آنچه شایسته‌ی آن‌ها بود را در روز سه‌شنبه و چهارشنبه، آفرید؛ چنانچه خدا فرموده: أَ‌إِنَّکُمْ لَتَکْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِی خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فِی یَوْمَیْنِ ... ثُمَّ اسْتَوی إِلَی السَّماءِ وَ هِیَ دُخانٌ؛ این دود از دم‌زدن آب بر آمد و خدا آن را یک آسمان نمود و سپس آن را در دو روز پنجشنبه و ج-معه از ه-م گشود و هفت آسمان نمود، و آن روز ج-معه نامیده شد، برای اینکه آفرینش آسمان‌ها و زمین در آن جمع شد. سپس خداوند متعال فرمود: وَ أَوْحی فِی کُلِّ سَماءٍ أَمْرَها؛ یعنی در هر آسمانی آفریده‌هایی از فرشته‌ها و دریاها و کوه‌های سرد ساخت.
9.en: And He created the mountains therein, and the sustenance of its people, and its trees, and what is appropriate for it in two days: on Tuesday and Wednesday, as the Exalted says: "Do you indeed disbelieve in Him who created the earth in two days?" up to His saying: "Then He directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke." That smoke was from the breath of the water when it exhaled. He made it one heaven, then He parted it and made it seven in two days: on Thursday and Friday. It was named Friday (al-Jumu'ah) because the creation of the heavens and the earth was gathered (jumi'a) in it. Then the Exalted said: "And He inspired in each heaven its command," meaning: He placed in each heaven its creation of angels, seas, and mountains of hail.
9.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 486
9.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 54, p. 312; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 54, p. 204; "up to His saying: Then He directed... to the end" is omitted.

9.ar: خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ مِنْ دُخَانٍ ثُمَّ ابْتَدَأَ خَلْقَ الْأَرْضِ یَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ وَ یَوْمَ الْإِثْنَیْنِ وَ ذَلِکَ قَوْلُهُ أَ إِنَّکُمْ لَتَکْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِی خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فِی یَوْمَیْنِ ثُمَّ قَدَّرَ فِیهَا أَقْوَاتَهَا فِی یَوْمِ الثَّلَاثَاءِ وَ یَوْمِ الْأَرْبِعَاءِ فَذَلِکَ قَوْلُهُ وَ قَدَّرَ فِیها أَقْواتَها فِی أَرْبَعَةِ أَیَّامٍ سَواءًلِلسَّائِلِینَ.
9.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (- سپس خلق زمین را در روز یک شنبه و روز دوشنبه آغاز کرد و این است کلام او: أَ‌إِنَّکُمْ لَتَکْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِی خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فِی یَوْمَیْنِ سپس قوت‌هایش را در روز سه‌شنبه و چهارشنبه مقرّر کرد، و این است کلام او: وَ قَدَّرَ فِیها أَقْواتَها فِی‌أَرْبَعَةِ أَیَّامٍ سَواءًلِلسَّائِلِینَ.
9.en: Allah created the heavens from smoke, then He began the creation of the earth on Sunday and Monday, and that is His saying: "Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days?" Then He determined its sustenance therein on Tuesday and Wednesday, and that is His saying: "And He determined therein its sustenance in four days, equal for those who ask."
9.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 488

9.ar: أَنَّ الْیَهُودَ أَتَتِ النَّبِیَّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَسَأَلَتْهُ عَنْ خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ فَقَالَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الْأَرْضَ یَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ وَ الْإِثْنَیْنِ وَ خَلَقَ الْجِبَالَ وَ مَا فِیهِنَّ مِنْ مَنَافِعَ یَوْمَ الثَّلَاثَاءِ وَ خَلَقَ یَوْمَ الْأَرْبِعَاءِ الشَّجَرَ وَ الْمَاءَ وَ الْمَدَائِنَ وَ الْعُمْرَانَ وَ الْخَرَابَ فَهَذِهِ أَرْبَعَةٌ فَقَالَ تَعَالَی قُلْ أَ إِنَّکُمْ لَتَکْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِی خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فِی یَوْمَیْنِ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ فِی أَرْبَعَةِ أَیَّامٍ سَواءً لِلسَّائِلِین.
9.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (- یهودیان نزد پیغمبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) آمدند و از خلق آسمان‌ها و زمین پرسیدند، فرمود: «خداوند متعال زمین را روز یک‌شنبه و دوشنبه آفرید، و کوه‌ها و منافع آن‌ها را روز سه‌شنبه، و در چهارشنبه درخت و آب و شهرها و آبادانی و ویرانی را آفرید، و این شد چهار روز و خدای متعال فرمود: قُلْ أَ ئنَّکُمْ لَتَکْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِی خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فیِ یَوْمَینْ‌ِ وَ تجْعَلُونَ لَهُ أَندَادًا ذَالِکَ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِینَ* وَ جَعَلَ فِیهَا رَوَاسیِ‌َ مِن فَوْقِهَا وَ بَارَکَ فِیهَا وَ قَدَّرَ فِیهَا أَقْوَاتهَا فیِ أَرْبَعَةِ أَیَّامٍ سَوَاءً لِّلسَّائلِین.
9.en: The Jews came to the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him and his family) and asked him about the creation of the heavens and the earth. He said: "Allah created the earth on Sunday and Monday, and He created the mountains and the benefits within them on Tuesday, and on Wednesday He created the trees, the water, the cities, the cultivation, and the desolation. These are four [days]." Then the Exalted said: "Say, 'Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days...'" up to His saying: "...in four days, equal for those who ask."
9.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 488
9.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 54, p. 209; Nur al-Thaqalayn; [with slight variations]

9.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ خَلَقَ الْخَیْرَ یَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ وَ مَا کَانَ لِیَخْلُقَ الشَّرَّ قَبْلَ الْخَیْرِ وَ فِی یَوْمِ الْأَحَدِ وَ الْإِثْنَیْنِ خَلَقَ الْأَرَضِینَ وَ خَلَقَ أَقْوَاتَهَا فِی یَوْمِ الثَّلَاثَاءِ وَ خَلَقَ السَّمَاوَاتِ یَوْمَ الْأَرْبِعَاءِ وَ یَوْمَ الْخَمِیسِ وَ خَلَقَ أَقْوَاتَهَا یَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ ذَلِکَ قَوْلُهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: خَلَقَ السَّماواتِ وَ الْأَرْضَ وَ ما بَیْنَهُما فِی سِتَّةِ أَیَّام.
9.en: Verily, Allah created goodness on Sunday, and it was not for Him to create evil before goodness. On Sunday and Monday, He created the earths, and He created their sustenance on Tuesday. He created the heavens on Wednesday and Thursday, and He created their sustenance on Friday. And that is the saying of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: "He created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days." (Furqan/ 4)
9.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 488
9.refs: al-Kafi, Vol. 8, p. 145; Nur al-Thaqalayn; al-Burhan

9.ar: أَنَّ رَجُلًا قَالَ لَهُ آیَتَانِ فِی کِتَابِ اللَّهِ تُخَالِفُ إِحْدَاهُمَا الْأُخْرَی فَقَالَ إِنَّمَا أَتَیْتُ مِنْ قِبَلِ رَأْیِکَ اقْرَأْ قَالَ قُلْ أَ إِنَّکُمْ لَتَکْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِی خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فِی یَوْمَیْنِ حَتَّی بَلَغَ ثُمَّ اسْتَوی إِلَی السَّماءِ وَ قَوْلُهُ وَ الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذلِکَ دَحاها قَالَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الْأَرْضَ قَبْلَ أَنْ یَخْلُقَ السَّمَاءَ ثُمَّ خَلَقَ السَّمَاءَ ثُمَّ دَحَا الْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَا خَلَقَ السَّمَاءَ وَ إِنَّمَا قَوْلُهُ دَحاها بَسَطَهَا.
9.en: A man said to him, "There are two verses in the Book of Allah that contradict one another." He replied, "That has only come from your own opinion. Read." He said, "Say: 'Do you indeed disbelieve in Him who created the earth in two days...' until he reached, '...then He directed Himself to the heaven,' and His saying, 'And the earth after that He spread out' (An-Nazi'at/30)." He said, "Allah created the earth before He created the heaven, then He created the heaven, then He spread out the earth after He had created the heaven. And the meaning of His saying 'dahaha' (spread it out) is that He expanded it."
9.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 488

9.ar: عَنْ أَبِی بَکْرٍ الْحَضْرَمِیِّ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) قَالَ خَرَجَ هِشَامُ بْنُ عَبْدِ الْمَلِکِ حَاجّاً وَ مَعَهُ الْأَبْرَشُ الْکَلْبِیُّ فَلَقِیَا أَبَاعَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) فِی الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ فَقَالَ هِشَامٌ لِلْأَبْرَشِ: تَعْرِفُ هَذَا؟ قَالَ: لَا. قَالَ: هَذَا الَّذِی تَزْعُمُ الشِّیعَةُ أَنَّهُ نَبِیٌّ مِنْ کَثْ-رَةِ عِلْمِهِ. فَقَالَ الْأَبْرَشُ: لَأَسْأَلَنَّهُ عَنْ مَس-ْأَلَةٍ لَا یُجِیبُنِی فِیهَا إِلَّا نَبِیٌّ أَوْ وَصِیُّ نَبِیٍّ. فَقَالَ هِشَامٌ لِلْأَبْرَشِ: وَدِدْتُ أَنَّکَ فَعَلْتَ ذَلِکَ. فَلَقِیَ الْأَبْرَشُ أَبَاعَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) فَقَالَ: یَا أَبَاعَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) أَخْبِرْنِی عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: أَ وَ لَمْ یَرَ الَّذِینَ کَفَرُوا أَنَّ السَّماواتِ وَ الْأَرْضَ کانَتا رَتْقاً فَفَتَقْناهُما؛ فَمَا کَانَ رَتْقُهُمَا وَ مَا کَانَ فَتْقُهُمَا؟ فَقَالَ: أَبُوعَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) یَا أَبْرَشُ هُوَ کَمَا وَصَفَ نَفْسَهُ کانَ عَرْشُهُ عَلَی الْماءِ وَ الْمَاءُ عَلَی الْهَوَاءِ وَ الْهَوَاءُ لَا یُحَدُّ وَ لَمْ یَکُنْ یَوْمَئِذٍ خَلْقٌ غَیْرُهُمَا وَ الْمَاءُ یَوْمَئِذٍ عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ یَخْلُقَ الْأَرْضَ أَمَرَ الرِّیَاحَ فَضَرَبَتِ الْمَاءَ حَتَّی صَارَ مَوْجاً ثُمَّ أَزْبَدَ فَصَارَ زَبَداً وَاحِداً فَجَمَعَهُ فِی مَوْضِعِ الْبَیْتِ ثُمَّ جَعَلَهُ جَبَلًا مِنْ زَبَدٍ ثُمَّ دَحَی الْأَرْضَ مِنْ تَحْتِهِ فَقَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی: إِنَّ أَوَّلَ بَیْتٍ وُضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذِی بِبَکَّةَ مُبارَکاً ثُمَّ مَکَثَ الرَّبُّ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی مَا شَاءَ فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ یَخْلُقَ السَّمَاءَ أَمَرَ الرِّیَاحَ فَضَرَبَتِ الْبُحُورَ حَتَّی أَزْبَدَتْهَا فَخَرَجَ مِنْ ذَلِکَ الْمَوْجُ وَ الزَّبَدُ مِنْ وَسَطِهِ دُخَانٌ سَاطِعٌ مِنْ غَیْرِ نَارٍ فَخَلَقَ مِنْهُ السَّمَاءَ فَجَعَلَ فِیهَا الْبُرُوجَ وَ النُّجُومَ وَ مَنَازِلَ الشَّمْسِ وَ الْقَمَرِ وَ أَجْرَاهَا فِی الْفَلَکِ وَ کَانَتِ السَّمَاءُ خَضْرَاءَ عَلَی لَوْنِ الْمَاءِ الْعَذْبِ الْأَخْضَرِ وَ کَانَتِ الْأَرْضُ خَضْرَاءَ عَلَی لَوْنِ الْمَاءِ وَ کَانَتَا مَرْتُوقَتَیْنِ لَیْسَ لَهُمَا أَبْوَابٌ وَ لَمْ یَکُنْ لِلْأَرْضِ أَبْوَابٌ وَ هُوَ النَّبْتُ وَ لَمْ تُمْطِرِ السَّمَاءُ عَلَیْهَا فَتُنْبِتَ فَفَتَقَ السَّمَاءَ بِالْمَطَرِ وَ فَتَقَ الْأَرْضَ بِالنَّبَاتِ وَ ذَلِکَ قَوْلُهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ: أَ وَ لَمْ یَرَ الَّذِینَ کَفَرُوا أَنَّ السَّماواتِ وَ الْأَرْضَ کانَتا رَتْقاً فَفَتَقْناهُما. فَقَالَ الْأَبْرَشُ: وَ اللَّهِ مَا حَدَّثَنِی بِمِثْلِ هَذَا الْحَدِیثِ أَحَدٌ قَطُّ أَعِدْ عَلَیَّ فَأَعَادَ عَلَیْهِ وَ کَانَ الْأَبْرَشُ مُلْحِداً فَقَالَ وَ أَنَا أَشْهَدُ أَنَّکَ ابْنُ نَبِیٍّ ثَلَاثَ مَرَّات.
9.en:
Abu Bakr al-Hadrami narrated from Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) who said: Hisham ibn Abd al-Malik went on Hajj, accompanied by al-Abrash al-Kalbi. They met Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) in the Sacred Mosque. Hisham said to al-Abrash, "Do you recognize this man?" He replied, "No." Hisham said, "This is the one whom the Shia claim is a prophet due to the abundance of his knowledge." Al-Abrash said, "I will certainly ask him a question that no one can answer except a prophet or the successor of a prophet." Hisham said to al-Abrash, "I would love for you to do that."

Al-Abrash met Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) and said, "O Abu Abd Allah, inform me about the saying of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: 'Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them?' (21:30). What was their joining and what was their separation?"

Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) said, "O Abrash, it is as He described Himself: 'His Throne was upon the water' (11:7), and the water was upon the air, and the air has no limit. On that day, there was no creation other than those two, and the water on that day was sweet and fresh. When He willed to create the earth, He commanded the winds to strike the water until it became waves, then it foamed, becoming a single mass of foam. He gathered it at the site of the House (the Kaaba), then made it into a mountain of foam, and then spread the earth from beneath it. Thus, Allah the Almighty said: 'Indeed, the first House [of worship] established for mankind was that at Bakkah [Makkah], blessed...' (3:96).

Then the Lord, Blessed and Exalted, remained as He willed. When He willed to create the heaven, He commanded the winds to strike the seas until they became foamy. From that wave and foam, there emerged from its center a rising smoke without fire, and from it, He created the heaven. He placed within it the constellations, the stars, and the stations of the sun and the moon, and set them in motion in their orbits. The heaven was green, the color of fresh green water, and the earth was green, the color of the water. Both were joined, having no doors. The earth was joined, having no doors—which are the plants—and the heaven did not rain upon it so that it might sprout. So He separated the heaven with rain and separated the earth with plants. That is the meaning of His saying, the Almighty and Majestic: 'Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them?'"

Al-Abrash said, "By Allah, no one has ever told me a hadith like this before. Repeat it for me." He repeated it for him. Al-Abrash, who was an atheist, said, "And I bear witness that you are the son of a prophet," repeating it three times.
9.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 488
9.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 54, p. 73; Nur al-Thaqalayn

10.ar: وَ هِیَ الصَّخْرَةُ الَّتِی ذَکَرَهَا لُقْمَانُ لَیْسَتْ فِی السَّمَاءِ وَ لَا فِی الْأَرْضِ فَتَحَرَّکَ الْحُوتُ وَ اضْطَرَبَتْ وَ تَزَلْزَلَتِ الْأَرْضُ فَأَرْسَی عَلَیْهَا الْجِبَالَ فَقَرَّتْ وَ الْجِبَالُ تَفْخَرُ عَلَی الْأَرْضِ فَذَلِکَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَی وَ جَعَلَ فِیها رَواسِیَ.
10.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (- همان صخره است که لقمان ذکر کرده نه در آسمان است و نه در زمین. ماهی جنبید و پریشان شد و زمین لرزید، و کوه‌ها را بر آن لنگر نمود و آرام شد و کوه‌ها بر زمین بالیدند و این است فرموده خدای متعال: وَ جَعَلَ فِیها رَواسِیَ.
10.en: It is the rock that Luqman mentioned; it is neither in the heaven nor on the earth. The whale moved and became agitated, and the earth shook, so He set the mountains upon it, and it became stable. The mountains boast over the earth, and that is the saying of the Exalted: "And He set therein firm mountains."
10.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 490

10.ar: أَنْبَتَ فِیهَا شَجَرَهَا وَ قَدَّرَ فِیها أَقْواتَها وَ أَهْلَهَا فِی أَرْبَعَةِ أَیَّامٍ سَواءً لِلسَّائِلِینَ یَقُولُ مَنْ سَأَلَ فَهَکَذَا الْأَمْر.
10.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (- درخت را در آن رویاند، و موادّ غذایی آن را مقدّر فرمود و اهلش را تقدیر کرد این‌ها همه در چهار روز بود؛ درست به‌اندازه‌ی نیاز تقاضاکنندگان. هرکه بپرسد کار اینچنین بوده است.
10.en: He caused its trees to grow therein, and He ordained therein its sustenance and its inhabitants in four days, equal for those who ask. He says: Whoever asks, then this is how the matter was.
10.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 492

10.ar: وَ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ (رحمة الله علیه) فِی قَوْلِهِ وَ قَدَّرَ فِیها أَقْواتَها قَالَ شَقَّ الْأَنْهَارَ وَ غَرَسَ الْأَشْجَارَ وَ وَضَعَ الْجِبَالَ وَ أَجْرَی الْبِحَارَ وَ جَعَلَ فِی هَذِهِ مَا لَیْسَ فِی هَذِهِ وَ فِی هَذِهِ مَا لَیْسَ فِی هَذِهِ.
10.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (- وَ قَدَّرَ فِیها أَقْواتَها جوی‌ها را شکافت، درخت‌ها را کشت، کوه‌ها را نهاد و دریاها را روان کرد، و در هرکدام فایده‌ای نهاد که در دیگری نیست.
10.en: Regarding His saying, "And He ordained therein its provisions," he said: He cleaved the rivers, planted the trees, set the mountains, caused the seas to flow, and placed in each of these that which is not in the other, and in that which is not in this.
10.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 492

10.ar: سَأَلُوهُ (علیه السلام) عَنْ لَفْظِ الْوَحْیِ فِی کِتَابِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی فَقَالَ مِنْهُ وَحْیُ النُّبُوَّةِ وَ مِنْهُ وَحْیُ الْإِلْهَامِ وَ مِنْهُ وَحْیُ الْإِشَارَةِ وَ مِنْهُ وَحْیُ أَمْرٍ وَ مِنْهُ وَحْیُ کَذِبٍ وَ مِنْهُ وَحْیُ تَقْدِیرٍ وَ مِنْهُ وَحْیُ خَبَرٍ وَ مِنْهُ وَحْیُ الرِّسَالَةِ ... وَ أَمَّا وَحْیُ التَّقْدِیرِ فَقَوْلُهُ تَعَالَی وَ أَوْحی فِی کُلِّ سَماءٍ أَمْرَها وَ قَدَّرَ فِیها أَقْواتَها.
10.fa: از امام علی (علیه السلام) پیرامون [کاربردِ] لفظ وحی در قرآن سؤال پرسیدند؛ حضرت در پاسخ فرمود: «یک قسم از آن وحی نبوّت، قسم دیگر وحی الهام، قسم دیگر وحی اشاره، قسم دیگر وحی فرمان، قسم دیگر وحی دروغین، قسم دیگر وحی تقدیر، قسم دیگر وحی خبر و قسمی وحی رسالت است؛.. امّا تفسیر وحی تقدیر، این کلام خداوند است [که فرمود:] وَ أَوْحی فِی کُلِّ سَماءٍ أَمْرَها وَ قَدَّرَ فِیها أَقْواتَها».
10.en: They asked him (peace be upon him) about the term 'wahy' (revelation/inspiration) in the Book of Allah the Exalted. He said: "It includes the revelation of prophethood, the revelation of inspiration (ilham), the revelation of indication (ishara), the revelation of command (amr), the revelation of falsehood (kadhib), the revelation of decree (taqdir), the revelation of news (khabar), and the revelation of message (risala)... As for the revelation of decree, it is His saying the Exalted: 'And He revealed in each heaven its command, and He decreed therein its sustenance' (41:12)."
10.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 492

10.ar: وَ جَعَلَ فِیها رَواسِیَ مِنْ فَوْقِها وَ بارَکَ فِیها وَ قَدَّرَ فِیها أَقْواتَها أَیْ لَا تَزُولُ وَ تَبْقَی فِی أَرْبَعَةِ أَیَّامٍ سَواءً لِلسَّائِلِینَ یَعْنِی فِی أَرْبَعَةِ أَوْقَاتٍ وَ هِیَ الَّتِی یُخْرِجُ اللَّهُ فِیهَا أَقْوَاتَ الْعَالَمِ مِنَ النَّاسِ وَ الْبَهَائِمِ وَ الطَّیْرِ وَ حَشَرَاتِ الْأَرْضِ وَ مَا فِی الْبَرِّ وَ الْبَحْرِ مِنَ الْخَلْقِ وَ الثِّمَارِ وَ النَّبَاتِ وَ الشَّجَرِ وَ مَا یَکُونُ فِیهِ مَعَایِشُ الْحَیَوَانِ کُلِّهِ وَ هُوَ الرَّبِیعُ وَ الصَّیْفُ وَ الْخَرِیفُ وَ الشِّتَاءُ.
10.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- سپس می‌فرماید: وجَعَل فِیهَا رَواسِیَ مِن فَوقِهَا وبَارَکَ فِیهَا وقَدَّرَ فِیهَا أَقْواتَهَا. یعنی نابود نمی‌شود و فناپذیر است. فِی أَرْبَعَةِ أَیَّامٍ سَواء للسَّائِلینَ یعنی در چهار وقت که خداوند در آن قوت‌های جهان اعمّ از مردم، چهارپایان، پرندگان، حشرات زمین و هر انسان، میوه، گیاه، درخت و مواد مورد نیاز جانداران را در آن چهار وقت آفرید که همان چهار فصل سال یعنی بهار، تابستان، پاییز و زمستان است.
10.en: "And He placed therein firm mountains rising above it, and He blessed it and ordained therein its provisions" — meaning, they do not vanish and they remain. "In four days, equal for those who ask" — meaning, in four times. These are the times in which Allah brings forth the provisions of the world for humans, livestock, birds, insects of the earth, and all creatures on land and sea, as well as fruits, plants, trees, and everything that constitutes the sustenance of all living beings. These are spring, summer, autumn, and winter.
10.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 492
10.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 54, p. 60; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 262; [The phrase "and the birds, insects..." to the end is omitted]; Al-Burhan

10.ar: عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاس (رحمة الله علیه) أَنَّ الْیَهُودَ أَتَتِ النَّبِیَّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَسَأَلَتْهُ عَنْ خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ فَقَالَ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الْأَرْضَ یَوْمَ الْأَحَدِ وَ الْإِثْنَیْنِ وَ خَلَقَ الْجِبَالَ وَ مَا فِیهِنَّ مِنْ مَنَافِعَ یَوْمَ الثَّلَاثَاءِ وَ خَلَقَ یَوْمَ الْأَرْبِعَاءِ الشَّجَرَ وَ الْمَاءَ وَ الْمَدَائِنَ وَ الْعُمْرَانَ وَ الْخَرَابَ فَهَذِهِ أَرْبَعَةٌ فَقَالَ تَعَالَی قُلْ أَ إِنَّکُمْ لَتَکْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِی خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فِی یَوْمَیْنِ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ فِی أَرْبَعَةِ أَیَّامٍ سَواءً لِلسَّائِلِینَ وَ خَلَقَ یَوْمَ الْخَمِیسِ السَّمَاءَ وَ خَلَقَ یَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ النُّجُومَ وَ الشَّمْسَ وَ الْقَمَرَ وَ الْمَلَائِکَةَ إِلَی ثَلَاثِ سَاعَاتٍ بَقِینَ مِنْهُ فَخَلَقَ فِی أَوَّلِ سَاعَةٍ مِنْ هَذِهِ الثَّلَاثِ الْآجَالَ حِینَ یَمُوتُ مَنْ مَاتَ وَ فِی الثَّانِیَةِ أَلْقَی الْآفَةَ عَلَی کُلِّ شَیْءٍ مِمَّا یُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ وَ فِی الثَّالِثَةِ خَلَقَ آدَمَ (علیه السلام) وَ أَسْکَنَهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَ أَمَرَ إِبْلِیسَ بِالسُّجُودِ لَهُ وَ أَخْرَجَهُ مِنْهَا فِی آخِرِ سَاعَة.
10.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (گوید: یهود نزد پیغمبر (صلی الله علیه و آله) آمدند و از خلق آسمان‌ها و زمین پرسیدند، فرمود: «خدا زمین را روز یک‌شنبه و دوشنبه آفرید، و کوه‌ها و منافع آن‌ها را روز سه‌شنبه، و در چهارشنبه درخت و آب و شهرها و آبادانی و ویرانی را آفرید، و این شد چهار روز و خدای تعالی فرمود: قُلْ أَ ئنَّکُمْ لَتَکْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِی خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فیِ یَوْمَینْ‌ِ وَ تجَعَلُونَ لَهُ أَندَادًا ذَالِکَ رَبُّ الْعَالَمِینَ* وَ جَعَلَ فِیهَا رَوَاسیِ‌َ مِن فَوْقِهَا وَ بَارَکَ فِیهَا وَ قَدَّرَ فِیهَا أَقْوَاتهَا فیِ أَرْبَعَةِ أَیَّامٍ سَوَاءً لِّلسَّائلِین. روز پنجشنبه آسمان را آفرید، و روز جمعه اختران و خورشید و ماه و فرشته‌ها تا سه ساعت به غروب که در اوّل ساعت آن برگ‌ها را آفرید، هنگامی‌که می‌میرد هرکه مرده و در دوّم آفت برای هر سودمند آفرید، و در سوّم آدم را آفرید و در بهشت جای داد و ابلیس را فرمود بر او سجده کند، و در ساعت آخر او را برآورد.
10.en: Ibn Abbas (may God have mercy on him) narrated that the Jews came to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and asked him about the creation of the heavens and the earth. He said: "God created the earth on Sunday and Monday. He created the mountains and the benefits within them on Tuesday. On Wednesday, He created the trees, water, cities, civilization, and desolation. These are four [days]. Then God the Exalted said: 'Say, do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days...' up to His saying: '...in four days, equal for those who ask.' He created the heaven on Thursday. On Friday, He created the stars, the sun, the moon, and the angels, until three hours remained of it. In the first of these three hours, He created the lifespans, [determining] when those who die will die. In the second, He cast blight upon everything that is benefited from. In the third, He created Adam (peace be upon him), settled him in Paradise, commanded Iblis to prostrate to him, and expelled him from it in the final hour."
10.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 492

11.ar: قَوْلُهُ ثُمَّ اسْتَوی إِلَی السَّماءِ أَیْ دَبَّرَ وَ خَلَقَ.
11.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- ثُمَّ اسْتَوی إِلی السَّمَاء یعنی آسمان را آفرید و تدبیر کرد.
11.en: His saying, "Then He directed Himself to the heaven," means He ordained and created it.
11.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 494
11.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 54, p. 60; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 263; and Nur al-Thaqalayn and Al-Burhan; "with slight variations"

11.ar: وَ أَصْلُ الِاسْتِوَاءِ الِاسْتِقَامَةُ وَ الْقَصْدُ التَّدْبِیرُ الْمُسْتَقِیمُ تَسْوِیَةً لَهُ.
11.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (- استواء در اصل به‌معنای استقامت و پایداری است و آهنگِ تدبیرِ استوارکردن، همان استواء در تدبیر است.
11.en: The root of 'istiwa' (rising/settling) is uprightness and stability, and the intent of 'tadbir' (governing/managing) is the upright management of affairs, as a way of perfecting it.
11.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 494

11.ar: عَنْ صَفْوَانَ بْنِ یَحْیَی قَالَ ... فَقَالَ أَبُوقُرَّةَ فَأَیْنَ اللَّهُ فَقَالَ أَبُوالْحَسَنِ (علیه السلام) الْأَیْنُ مَکَانٌ وَ هَذِهِ مَسْأَلَةُ شَاهِدٍ عَنْ غَائِبٍ وَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی لَیْسَ بِغَائِبٍ وَ لَا یَقْدَمُهُ قَادِمٌ وَ هُوَ بِکُلِّ مَکَانٍ مَوْجُودٌ مُدَبِّرٌ صَانِعٌ حَافِظٌ مُمْسِکُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ فَقَالَ أَبُوقُرَّةَ أَ لَیْسَ هُوَ فَوْقَ السَّمَاءِ دُونَ مَا سِوَاهَا فَقَالَ أَبُوالْحَسَنِ (علیه السلام) هُوَ اللَّهُ فِی السَّماواتِ وَ فِی الْأَرْضِ وَ هُوَ الَّذِی فِی السَّماءِ إِلهٌ وَ فِی الْأَرْضِ إِلهٌ وَ هُوَ الَّذِی یُصَوِّرُکُمْ فِی الْأَرْحامِ کَیْفَ یَشاءُ وَ هُوَ مَعَکُمْ أَیْنَ ما کُنْتُمْ وَ هُوَ الَّذِی اسْتَوی إِلَی السَّماءِ وَ هِیَ دُخان.
11.fa: صفوان‌بن‌یحیی گوید: ...ابو قرّه گفت: «خدا کجا است»؟ امام رضا (علیه السلام) فرمود: «کجا مکان است و این را کسی سؤال می‌کند که اینجا هست. درباره‌ی کسی که اینجا نیست [می‌گوید فلانی کجا است]. خدا غایب نیست و کسی پیش او نمی‌رود. او در هر مکانی است. موجود و مدبّر و صانع و حافظ است و نگهدار آسمان‌ها و زمین است». ابوقرّه گفت: «مگر خدا بالای آسمان‌ها و زمین نیست بالاتر از هرچه که هست». فرمود: «او خدای آسمان‌ها و زمین است. او کسی است که در آسمان خدا است و در زمین خدا است. او به شما در رحم مادر به هر صورتی که بخواهد شکل می‌دهد. او با شما است هرکجا باشید و اسْتَوی إِلَی السَّماءِ وَ هِیَ دُخان اوست که تسلّط بر آسمان دارد، با اینکه به صورت گاز است».
11.en: Safwan ibn Yahya said: ... Abu Qurrah asked, "Where is Allah?" Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) replied, "The word 'where' refers to a place, and this is a question asked by one who is present about one who is absent. Allah the Exalted is not absent, nor is He preceded by anyone. He is present in every place; He is the Disposer of affairs, the Creator, the Guardian, and the Sustainer of the heavens and the earth." Abu Qurrah said, "Is He not above the heaven, distinct from everything else?" Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him) replied, "He is Allah in the heavens and in the earth. He is the One who is God in the heaven and God in the earth. He is the One who fashions you in the wombs as He wills. He is with you wherever you are, and He is the One who directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke."
11.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 494

11.ar: ثُمَّ اسْتَوی إِلَی السَّماءِ وَ هِیَ دُخانٌ فَسَمَکَهَا وَ زَیَّنَهَا بِالنُّجُومِ وَ الشَّمْسِ وَ الْقَمَرِ وَ أَجْرَاهُمَا فِی فَلَکِهِمَا.
11.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (- سپس به آفرینش آسمان پرداخت، درحالی‌که به صورت دود بود، و آن را برافراشت و به ستارگان و خورشید و ماه آراست و در فلک آن‌ها را گرداند.
11.en: "Then He directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke, and He raised it and adorned it with the stars, the sun, and the moon, and caused them to run in their orbits."
11.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 494

11.ar: خَلَقَ الشَّیْءَ الَّذِی جَمِیعُ الْأَشْیَاءِ مِنْهُ وَ هُوَ الْمَاءُ الَّذِی خَلَقَ الْأَشْیَاءَ مِنْهُ فَجَعَلَ نَسَبَ کُلِّ شَیْءٍ إِلَی الْمَاءِ وَ لَمْ یَجْعَلْ لِلْمَاءِ نَسَباً یُضَافُ إِلَیْهِ وَ خَلَقَ الرِّیحَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ ثُمَّ سَلَّطَ الرِّیحَ عَلَی الْمَاءِ فَشَقَّقَتِ الرِّیحُ مَتْنَ الْمَاءِ حَتَّی ثَارَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ زَبَدٌ عَلَی قَدْرِ مَا شَاءَ أَنْ یَثُورَ فَخَلَقَ مِنْ ذَلِکَ الزَّبَدِ أَرْضاً بَیْضَاءَ نَقِیَّةً لَیْسَ فِیهَا صَدْعٌ وَ لَا ثَقْبٌ وَ لَا صُعُودٌ وَ لَا هُبُوطٌ وَ لَا شَجَرَةٌ ثُمَّ طَوَاهَا فَوَضَعَهَا فَوْقَ الْمَاءِ ثُمَّ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ النَّارَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ فَشَقَّقَتِ النَّارُ مَتْنَ الْمَاءِ حَتَّی ثَارَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ دُخَانٌ عَلَی قَدْرِ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ أَنْ یَثُورَ فَخَلَقَ مِنْ ذَلِکَ الدُّخَانِ سَمَاءً صَافِیَةً نَقِیَّةً لَیْسَ فِیهَا صَدْعٌ وَ لَا ثَقْبٌ وَ ذَلِکَ قَوْلُهُ: السَّماءُ بَناها* رَفَعَ سَمْکَها فَسَوَّاها* وَ أَغْطَشَ لَیْلَها وَ أَخْرَجَ ضُحاها.
11.en: He created the thing from which all things originate, and that is water, from which He created all things. He attributed everything to water, but did not attribute water to anything that it could be traced back to. He created the wind from the water, then empowered the wind over the water, so the wind split the surface of the water until foam rose from the water to the extent that He willed it to rise. From that foam, He created a white, pure earth, in which there was no crack, no hole, no ascent, no descent, and no tree. Then He folded it and placed it upon the water. Then Allah created fire from the water, and the fire split the surface of the water until smoke rose from the water to the extent that Allah willed it to rise. From that smoke, He created a clear, pure heaven, in which there was no crack and no hole. And that is His saying: "The heaven, We built it with power, and indeed, We are its expander. And He darkened its night and brought out its brightness." (Adh-Dhariyat/ 47)
11.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 494

11.ar: کَانَ کُلُّ شَیْءٍ مَاءً وَ کَانَ عَرْشُهُ عَلَی الْمَاءِ فَأَمَرَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ ذِکْرُهُ الْمَاءَ فَاضْطَرَمَ نَاراً ثُمَّ أَمَرَ النَّارَ فَخَمَدَتْ فَارْتَفَعَ مِنْ خُمُودِهَا دُخَانٌ فَخَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ مِنْ ذَلِکَ الدُّخَانِ وَ خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ مِنَ الرَّمَاد.
11.fa: همه چیز آب بود، و عرش خدا بر آب بود، و خدا عزّوجلّ به آب فرمان داد تا بر افروخت و آتش گرفت، سپس به آتش فرمود تا خاموش شد و از خاموشی آن دودی برخاست و خدا آسمان‌ها و زمین را از آن دود آفرید.
11.en: Everything was water, and His Throne was upon the water. Then Allah, Mighty is His remembrance, commanded the water, and it blazed into fire. Then He commanded the fire, and it extinguished. From its extinguishing, a smoke rose, and Allah created the heavens from that smoke and created the earth from the ashes.
11.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 496

11.ar: فَمِنْ شَوَاهِدِ خَلْقِهِ خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ مُوَطَّدَاتٍ بِلَا عَمَدٍ قَائِمَاتٍ بِلَا سَنَدٍ دَعَاهُنَّ فَأَجَبْنَ طَائِعَاتٍ مُذْعِنَاتٍ غَیْرَ مُتَلَکِّئَاتٍ وَ لَا مُبْطِئَاتٍ وَ لَوْ لَا إِقْرَارُهُنَّ لَهُ بِالرُّبُوبِیَّةِ وَ إِذْعَانُهُنَّ بِالطَّوَاعِیَةِ لَمَا جَعَلَهُنَّ مَوْضِعاً لِعَرْشِهِ وَ لَا مَسْکَناً لِمَلَائِکَتِهِ وَ لَا مَصْعَداً لِلْکَلِمِ الطَّیِّبِ وَ الْعَمَلِ الصَّالِحِ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ.
11.fa: از نشانه‌های آفرینش خداوند، خلقت آسمان‌هاست که بدون ستون برجا و بدون تکیه‌گاه برپاست، خداوند آن‌ها را به اطاعت خویش دعوت فرمود و آن‌ها مطیع و با اقرار، بدون درنگ و تأخیر پاسخ دادند، و اگر اقرار آسمان‌ها به ربوبیّت و اعترافشان به فرمانبرداری از او نبود آن‌ها را محلّ عرش خویش، و جایگاه فرشتگان، و محلّ بالارفتن گفتار نیکو و کردار شایسته‌ی بندگانش قرار نمی‌داد.
11.en: Among the evidences of His creation is the creation of the heavens, established without pillars and standing without supports. He called them, and they answered, obedient and submissive, without hesitation or delay. Had it not been for their acknowledgment of His Lordship and their submission in obedience to Him, He would not have made them a place for His Throne, nor a dwelling for His angels, nor a place of ascent for the good words and righteous deeds of His creation.
11.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 496
11.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 4, p. 313; Nur al-Thaqalayn; "Fa-min shawahidi khalqihi... min khalqihi wa fihi" is omitted, and "ashrajaha" is a substitute for "ashrahaha".

11.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (- [منظور از دُخَان] بخار زمین بوده.
11.en: It was the vapor of the earth.
11.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), vol. 13, p. 496

11.ar: فَقَالَ کَعْبٌ یَا أَبَاالْحَسَنِ (علیه السلام) أَخْبِرْنِی عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی فِی کِتَابِهِ وَ کانَ عَرْشُهُ عَلَی الْماءِ لِیَبْلُوَکُمْ أَیُّکُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا قَالَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ علی بن ابی طالب (علیه السلام) نَعَمْ کَانَ عَرْشُهُ عَلَی الْمَاءِ حِینَ لَا أَرْضٌ مَدْحِیَّةٌ وَ لَا سَمَاءٌ مَبْنِیَّةٌ وَ لَا صَوْتٌ یُسْمَعُ وَ لَا عَیْنٌ تَنْبُعُ وَ لَا مَلَکٌ مُقَرَّبٌ وَ لَا نَبِیٌّ مُرْسَلٌ وَ لَا نَجْمٌ یَسْرِی وَ لَا قَمَرٌ یَجْرِی وَ لَا شَمْسٌ تُضِیءُ وَ عَرْشُهُ عَلَی الْمَاءِ غَیْرُ مُسْتَوْحِشٍ إِلَی أَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِهِ یُمَجِّدُ نَفْسَهُ وَ یُقَدِّسُهَا کَمَا شَاءَ أَنْ یَکُونَ کَانَ ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُ أَنْ یَخْلُقَ الْخَلْقَ فَضَرَبَ بِأَمْوَاجِ الْبُحُورِ فَثَارَ مِنْهَا مِثْلُ الدُّخَانِ کَأَعْظَمِ مَا یَکُونُ مِنْ خَلْقِ اللَّهِ فَبَنَی بِهَا سَمَاءً رَتْقاً ثُمَّ دَحَا الْأَرْضَ مِنْ مَوْضِعِ الْکَعْبَةِ وَ هِیَ وَسَطُ الْأَرْضِ فَطَبَقَتْ إِلَی الْبِحَارِ ثُمَّ فَتَقَهَا بِالْبُنْیَانِ وَ جَعَلَهَا سَبْعاً بَعْدَ إِذْ کَانَتْ وَاحِدَةً ثُمَّ اسْتَوی إِلَی السَّماءِ وَ هِیَ دُخانٌ مِنْ ذَلِکَ الْمَاءِ الَّذِی أَنْشَأَهُ مِنْ تِلْکَ الْبُحُورِ فَجَعَلَهَا سَبْعاً طِبَاقاً بِکَلِمَتِهِ الَّتِی لَا یَعْلَمُهَا غَیْرُهُ وَ جَعَلَ فِی کُلِّ سَمَاءٍ سَاکِناً مِنَ الْمَلَائِکَةِ خَلَقَهُمْ مَعْصُومِینَ مِنْ نُورٍ مِنْ بُحُورٍ عَذَبَةٍ وَ هُوَ بَحْرُ الرَّحْمَةِ وَ جَعَلَ طَعَامَهُمُ التَّسْبِیحَ وَ التَّهْلِیلَ وَ التَّقْدِیسَ.
11.en: Ka'b said, "O Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), inform me about the words of God Almighty in His Book: 'And His Throne was upon the water, that He might test you, which of you is best in deed.' (Hud/7)" Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) said, "Yes, His Throne was upon the water when there was no spread-out earth, no constructed heaven, no sound to be heard, no spring gushing forth, no angel brought near, no messenger prophet, no star traveling, no moon orbiting, and no sun shining. His Throne was upon the water, not needing any of His creation; He glorified Himself and sanctified Himself as He willed to be. Then, it occurred to Him to create the creation, so He struck the waves of the seas, and from them rose something like smoke, the greatest of what exists of God's creation. With it, He built a solid heaven. Then, He spread out the earth from the location of the Ka'bah, which is the center of the earth, and it covered the seas. Then, He parted it with construction and made it seven after it had been one. Then, He turned to the heaven, which was smoke from that water which He had originated from those seas, and He made it seven layers by His word, which no one knows except Him. He placed in every heaven inhabitants from among the angels, whom He created infallible from a light from sweet seas, which is the Sea of Mercy, and He made their food glorification (tasbih), declaration of oneness (tahlil), and sanctification (taqdis)."
11.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 496

11.ar: أَنَّ أَوَّلَ مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ عَزَّوجَلَّ الْمَاءُ فَکَانَ عَرْشُهُ عَلَیْهِ فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ أَنْ یَخْلُقَ السَّمَاءَ أَخْرَجَ مِنَ الْمَاءِ دُخَاناً فَارْتَفَعَ فَوْقَ الْمَاءِ فَسُمِّیَ السَّمَاءَ ثُمَّ أَیْبَسَ الْمَاءَ فَجَعَلَهُ أَرْضاً وَاحِدَةً ثُمَّ فَتَقَهَا فَجَعَلَهَا سَبْعَ أَرَضِینَ فِی یَوْمَیْنِ فِی الْأَحَدِ وَ الْإِثْنَیْنِ وَ خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ عَلَی حُ-وتٍ وَ الْحُوتُ هُوَ الَّذِی ذَکَرَهُ اللَّهُ فِی کِتَابِهِ ن وَ الْقَلَمِ وَ ما یَسْطُرُونَ وَ الْحُوتُ وَ الْمَاءُ عَلَی الصَّفَا وَ الصَّفَا عَلَی ظَهْرِ مَلَکٍ وَ الْمَلَکُ عَلَی صَخْرَةٍ وَ الصَّخْرَةُ عَلَی الرِّیحِ وَ هِیَ الصَّخْرَةُ الَّتِی فِی الْقُرْآنِ فَتَکُنْ فِی صَخْرَةٍ فَاضْطَرَبَ الْحُوتُ فَتَزَلْزَلَتِ الْأَرْضُ فَأَرْسَی اللَّهُ عَلَیْهَا الْجِبَالَ فَقَرَّتْ کَمَا قَالَ تَعَالَی أَنْ تَمِیدَ بِکُمْ وَ خَلَقَ الْجِبَالَ فِیهَا وَ خَلَقَ أَقْوَاتَ أَهْلِهَا وَ شَجَرَهَا وَ مَا یَنْبَغِی لَهَا فِی یَوْمَیْنِ فِی یَوْمِ الثَّلَاثَاءِ وَ یَوْمِ الْأَرْبِعَاءِ کَمَا قَالَ تَعَالَی أَ إِنَّکُمْ لَتَکْفُرُونَ بِالَّذِی خَلَقَ الْأَرْضَ فِی یَوْمَیْنِ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ ثُمَّ اسْتَوی إِلَی السَّماءِ وَ هِیَ دُخانٌ فَکَانَ ذَلِکَ الدُّخَانُ مِنْ نَفْسِ الْمَاءِ حِینَ تَنَفَّسَ فَجَعَلَهَا سَمَاءً وَاحِدَةً ثُمَّ فَتَقَهَا وَ جَعَلَهَا سَبْعاً فِی یَوْمَیْنِ فِی یَوْمِ الْخَمِیسِ وَ یَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ وَ إِنَّمَا سُمِّیَ بِالْجُمُعَةِ لِأَنَّهُ جُمِعَ فِیهِ خَلْقُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْض.
11.en: The first thing that Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, created was water, and His Throne was upon it. When He willed to create the heaven, He brought forth smoke from the water, which rose above the water and was named "the heaven." Then He dried the water and made it a single earth, then He split it and made it into seven earths in two days: Sunday and Monday. He created the earth upon a whale (hut), and the whale is that which Allah mentioned in His Book: "Nun. By the Pen and what they inscribe" (Qalam: 1). The whale and the water are upon the Safa (a rock), and the Safa is upon the back of an angel, and the angel is upon a rock, and the rock is upon the wind; and this is the rock mentioned in the Quran: "it be in a rock" (Luqman: 16). The whale stirred, and the earth shook, so Allah set the mountains upon it, and it became stable, as the Almighty said: "lest it shake with you" (Luqman: 10). He created the mountains within it, and created the sustenance of its inhabitants, its trees, and what is appropriate for it in two days: Tuesday and Wednesday, as the Almighty said: "Say, 'Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days...'" up to His saying: "Then He directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke" (Fussilat: 9-11). This smoke came from the breath of the water when it breathed, and He made it a single heaven, then He split it and made it seven in two days: Thursday and Friday. It was named Jumu'ah (Friday) because the creation of the heavens and the earth was gathered (jumi'a) in it.
11.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 496

11.ar: وَ قَدْ سُئِلَ أَبُوالْحَسَنِ الرِّضَا (علیه السلام) عَمَّنْ کَلَّمَ اللَّهَ لَا مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَ لَا مِنَ الْإِنْسِ فَقَالَ السَّمَاوَاتُ وَ الْأَرْضُ فِی قَوْلِهِ ائْتِیا طَوْعاً أَوْ کَرْهاً قالَتا أَتَیْنا طائِعِینَ.
11.fa: از امام رضا (علیه السلام) درباره‌ی مخلوقاتی غیر از انسان‌ها و جنیّان که خدا با آن‌ها سخن گفته است، سؤال شد. امام (علیه السلام) فرمود: «آسمان‌ها و زمین! خداوند می‌فرماید: اِئْتِیَا طَوعًا أَو کَرْهًا قَالتَا أَتَیْنَا طَائِعِینَ».
11.en: Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) was asked about those whom Allah spoke to, who were neither from the jinn nor from mankind. He replied: "The heavens and the earth, regarding His saying: 'Come, willingly or unwillingly,' to which they replied: 'We have come willingly.'"
11.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 498
11.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 54, p. 60/ Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 262; "with variation"/ Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 263/ Nur al-Thaqalayn/ Al-Burhan

11.ar: عَنْ جَابِرٍ الْجُعْفِیِّ قَالَ: قَالَ أَبُوجَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) لِمَ سُمِّیَتْ یَوْمُ الْجُمُعَةِ یَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ قَالَ قُلْتُ تُخْبِرُنِی جَعَلَنِیَ اللَّهُ فِدَاکَ قَالَ أَ فَلَا أُخْبِرُکَ بِتَأْوِیلِهِ الْأَعْظَمِ قَالَ قُلْتُ بَلَی جَعَلَنِیَ اللَّهُ فِدَاکَ فَقَالَ یَا جَابِرُ سَمَّی اللَّهُ الْجُمُعَةَ جُمُعَةً لِأَنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّوجَلَّ جَمَعَ فِی ذَلِکَ الْیَوْمِ الْأَوَّلِینَ وَ الْآخِرِینَ وَ جَمِیعَ مَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ مِنَ الْجِنِّ وَ الْإِنْسِ وَ کُلَّ شَیْءٍ خَلَقَ رَبُّنَا وَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرَضِینَ وَ الْبِحَارَ وَ الْجَنَّةَ وَ النَّارَ وَ کُلَّ شَیْءٍ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ فِی الْمِیثَاقِ فَأَخَذَ الْمِیثَاقَ مِنْهُمْ لَهُ بِالرُّبُوبِیَّةِ وَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ (صلی الله علیه و آله) بِالنُّبُوَّةِ وَ لِعَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) بِالْوَلَایَةِ وَ فِی ذَلِکَ الْیَوْمِ قَالَ اللَّهُ لِلسَّمَاوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضِ ائْتِیا طَوْعاً أَوْ کَرْهاً قالَتا أَتَیْنا طائِعِینَ.
11.fa: جابر جعفی گوید: امام باقر (علیه السلام) فرمود: «چرا جمعه را به این نام نامیده‌اند». گفتم: «فدایت شوم! مرا از آن آگاه فرمایید». فرمود: «برایت تأویل و تفسیر اعظم آن را نگویم»؟! عرض کردم: «چرا ای پسر رسول خدا (صلی الله علیه و آله)! بفرمایید». فرمود: «جابر! این روز را جمعه نامیده‌اند چون در این روز خدا تمام جهانیان را از اوّلین و آخرین جمع کرد و هرچه از جنّ و انس و تمام مخلوقات آسمان‌ها و زمین و دریاها و بهشت و جهنّم آفریده و هرچه به وجود آورده در میثاق (محلّ پیمان‌نامه) از تمام آن‌ها به ربوبیّت و برای محمّد (صلی الله علیه و آله) به نبوّت و برای علی (علیه السلام) به ولایت پیمان گرفت و در همین روز خداوند به آسمان‌ها و زمین فرمود: ائْتِیا طَوْعاً أَوْ کَرْهاً* قالَتا أَتَیْنا طائِعِین».
11.en: Jabir al-Ju'fi said: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said, "Why is the day of Friday (Jumu'ah) called Jumu'ah?" I said, "May God make me your sacrifice, will you inform me?" He said, "Shall I not inform you of its greatest interpretation?" I said, "Yes, may God make me your sacrifice." He said, "O Jabir, God named Friday 'Jumu'ah' because on that day, God (Mighty and Majestic is He) gathered the first and the last, and all that God created of jinn and mankind, and everything our Lord created—the heavens, the earths, the seas, Paradise, and the Fire—and everything God created in the Covenant (al-mithaq). He took the covenant from them for His Lordship, for Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) for Prophethood, and for Ali (peace be upon him) for Guardianship (Wilayah). And on that day, God said to the heavens and the earth: 'Come, willingly or unwillingly.' They said: 'We come willingly.'"
11.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 498
11.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 399; Al-Ikhtisas, p. 128; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 54, p. 60; [with slight variations]

11.ar: أَتَتِ السَّماءُ بِمَا فِیهَا مِنَ الشَّمْسِ وَ الْقَمَرِ وَ النُّجُومِ وَ أَتَتِ الْأَرْضُ بِمَا فِیهَا مِنَ الْأَنْهَارِ وَ الأَشْجَارِ وَ الثِّمَارِ وَ لَیْسَ هُنَاکَ أَمْرٌ بِالْقَوْلِ عَلَی الْحَقِیقَةِ وَ لَا جَوَابٌ لِذَلِکَ الْقَوْلِ بَلْ أَخْبَرَ اللهُ سُبْحَانَهُ مِنِ اخْتِرَاعِهِ السَّمَوَاتِ وَ الْأَرْضَ وَ إِنْشَائِهِ لَهُمَا مِنْ غَیْرِ تَعَذُّرٍ وَ لَا کُلْفَةٍ وَ لَا مَشَقَّةٍ بِمَنْزِلَةِ مَا یُقَالُ لِلْمَأْمُورِ: افْعَلْ، فَیَفْعَلُ مِنْ غَیْرِ تَلَبُّثٍ وَ لَا تَوَقُّفٍ فَعَبَّرَ عَنْ ذَلِکَ بِالْأَمْرِ وَ الطَّاعَةِ وَ هُوَ کَقَوْلِهِ إِنَّمَا أَمْرُهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ شَیْئاً أَنْ یَقُولَ لَهُ کُنْ فَیَکُونُ.
11.en: The heaven came with what it contains of the sun, the moon, and the stars, and the earth came with what it contains of rivers, trees, and fruits. There was no command spoken in reality, nor was there a response to such a command. Rather, Allah (Glorified be He) informed [us] of His invention of the heavens and the earth and His creation of them without difficulty, burden, or hardship, similar to what is said to one who is commanded: "Do," and he does it without delay or hesitation. Thus, He expressed this through [the metaphor of] command and obedience. This is like His saying: "His command, when He intends a thing, is only that He says to it, 'Be,' and it is."
11.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 13, p. 498
